programme.desc: A profile of James Coburn, the tough-guy actor in films that included Our Man Flint and The Magnificent Seven, who won an Academy Award in 1998 for his role in Affliction.

programme.title: Benetton Formula
programme.desc: The history of the Formula 1 team led by Alessandro Benetton, told through the memories of its key members and archive footage

programme.title: Seen & Heard: The History of Black Television
programme.desc: Part one of two. Documentary exploring African-American representation in Hollywood and TV, showcasing the creators and artists who shaped it. From Amos 'n' Andy to The Jeffersons and Good Times, black representation was historically shaped by white writers and creators, but in the 1990s, a rise in shows made by black people brought social issues to the forefront

programme.title: Seen & Heard: The History of Black Television
programme.desc: Part two of two. Black creators discuss taking ownership of the narrative while highlighting the need for opportunities at every level of the industry

programme.title: Wilder
programme.desc: A profile of comedy actor Gene Wilder, using a mix of interview and performance archive to follow his journey from neurotic outsider to unlikely leading man

programme.title: I'm Chevy Chase and You're Not
programme.desc: Chevy Chase was a cast member on the inaugural series of Saturday Night Live and he built on that success to star in numerous Hollywood comedies and host the Academy Awards. He played hapless father Clark Griswold in the National Lampoon films and ran amok in pictures including Caddyshack, Spies Like Us, Fletch and Three Amigos. Two-time Emmy Award winner Marina Zenovich directs an authorised feature-length documentary portrait of Chase, which includes rare and intimate home movies and archive footage. Chase and his family share memories directly to camera, enriched with contributions from friends and collaborators including Dan Aykroyd, Beverly D'Angelo, Goldie Hawn, Lorne Michaels, Ryan Reynolds and Martin Short.

Narrated by Whoopi Goldberg and Donald Sutherland

programme.title: When We Were Kings

The film explores the impact of Ali's visit to Africa before focusing on the epic fight, dubbed the 'Rumble in the Jungle', which has gone down in history as one of the greatest of all time. Spike Lee and Norman Mailer are among the contributors offering personal opinions on its importance to them

programme.title: I'm Carl Lewis!

programme.title: Krapopolis
programme.desc: After Deliria calls them out for being hypocrites, Ty and Hippo decide to rescue their hero Prometheus, from Zeus' eternal punishment.

programme.title: Krapopolis
programme.desc: When Shlub is accused of murdering all the city's goats, Ty is forced to invent a system of justice to try and exonerate him. Meanwhile, Hippo creates a new religion.

programme.title: Krapopolis

programme.desc: Nancy arrives back in the Square to speak to Johnny for legal advice, but she's adamant she doesn't want Linda to know. Nicola continues to struggle with Ned after he blackmailed her for a share in Harry's Barn, and Harvey tries to help Kathy as she prepares to welcome Ian home

programme.desc: Linda is shocked when she learns what's really going on, and George manages to calm Nicola following her run-in with Gemma. Harvey tries to step up for Kathy by cleaning the chippy ahead of an inspection, but it's clear he's taken on too much

programme.desc: As the first banishment unfolds, the faithful are hoping that they've caught a traitor, while the traitors themselves are desperate to keep their identities concealed. programme.title: The Celebrity Traitors
programme.desc: As the players go deeper into the game, a new day brings new suspicions amongst the faithful. The mission forces the celebrities to work in teams under terrifying conditions, and with the murdering hour approaching, the players take their seats at the round table

While there, she joins up with a lawless band of misfits who are searching for a legendary vault - and Lilith's mark might hold the key.

programme.title: A Stitch in Time

Judges Joanna MacGregor, Ben Gernon and Peter Moore then reveal the names of the eight musicians they want to see and hear again in the next round

programme.title: Talking Shakespeare
programme.desc: Celia Imrie trawls through the BBC archive for a celebration of the works of Shakespeare, and how his biggest works have been brought to cinema and TV over the years. The story is told through a selection of interviews with stars from the 1950s right up to the present day, with insights revealing how Shakespeare's plays have been continuously adapted to suit each new generation. Max Stafford-Clark's 1991 adaptation of Caryl Churchill's play, starring Lesley Manville

programme.title: BBC News

programme.desc: In September 1939 a German U-boat fires its first torpedo, setting in motion the longest continuous battle of the war. A cat and mouse game of epic proportions ensues as German U-boats and allied forces engage in a five-year battle for supremacy in the Atlantic

programme.title: WWII in Colour: Road to Victory
programme.desc: With Britain standing alone, Churchill realises maintaining control of the vital oil supply line through the Suez Canal is critical to his nation’s hopes. After the fall of the strategically important port of Tobruk, Rommel only has the defensive line at El Alamein left to cross. Britain’s General Montgomery drives Rommel back from El Alamein, but that is only the beginning; America’s rookie troops make landfall in North Africa and join the fight

programme.title: WWII in Colour: Road to Victory
programme.desc: In the aftermath of his defeat at Stalingrad, Hitler knows he must deliver a knockout blow to regain the initiative against his nemesis, Stalin. As his physical and mental abilities start to wane, Hitler prepares for battle at the bulge in the lines at Kursk with powerful new tanks backed up by some of the best troops of the war

programme.title: WWII in Colour: Road to Victory
programme.desc: After victory in North Africa, Britain and the United States prepare for their first assault on Axis-controlled Europe. The Americans want to attack Nazi Germany through France but the British fear a bloodbath. They persuade their Allies to launch a huge amphibious invasion of Sicily and then Italy instead

programme.title: Nazi's Diplomats: Dancing with the Devil
programme.desc: Examining how Otto Abetz (Hitler's ambassador in Paris) and Fernand de Brinon (ambassador of the Vichy government) pushed Franco-German collaboration in Nazi-occupied France. A regime operated through terror and oppression but also through cooperation and seduction

programme.title: Women of World War II: More Untold Stories
programme.desc: With rare archival footage and revealing interviews, this documentary tells the unknown stories of the women who enabled Allied victory in the Second World War. It honours their accomplishments with moving tributes from the history-makers and people they inspired.

programme.title: 28 Years Later: The Bone Temple
programme.desc: Dr Kelson finds himself in a shocking new relationship with consequences that could change the world as he knows it. Horror sequel, starring Ralph Fiennes, Jack O'Connell and Alfie Williams

programme.title: The Crow
programme.desc: Eric and Shelly meet in rehabilitation and fall in love. When a ruthless criminal has them murdered, Eric is resurrected and granted supernatural powers. Guided by a mysterious spirit, he hunts those responsible through an underworld, hoping his vengeance will give him one chance to save Shelly's soul from damnation. Dark fantasy based on James O'Barr's cult comic book, starring Bill Skarsgård, FKA twigs, Danny Huston and Josette Simon

programme.title: Rabbit Trap
programme.desc: Married musicians Daphne and Darcy Davenport moved from London to a cottage in Wales to complete their new album. By accident they record a mystical sound never heard before, and gradually disconnect from reality. Writer/director Bryn Chainey's horror, starring Dev Patel and Rosy McEwen

programme.title: Sky Cinema Preview - Oct 2026
programme.desc: Previews of the films now playing on Sky Cinema, plus other highlights showing on Sky

programme.title: The Moment
programme.desc: A fictionalised version of pop star Charli XCX navigates the complexities of fame and industry pressure while preparing for her arena tour debut. Mockumentary, starring Charli XCX, Rosanna Arquette and Kate Berlant

programme.title: Hitpig!
programme.desc: A pig who works as a bounty hunter finds himself trekking the globe with a free-spirited elephant he intended to capture. Animated comedy, with the voices of Jason Sudeikis, Lilly Singh and Rainn Wilson

programme.title: Nirvanna the Band the Show the Movie
programme.desc: When a scheme to book a show at a local nightspot goes disastrously wrong, Toronto musicians Matt and Jay are unexpectedly transported back to 2008. Fantasy comedy, starring Matt Johnson and Jay McCarrol

programme.title: Mother's Pride
programme.desc: A grieving family who own a failing pub have their lives changed by brewing real ale and entering the Great British Beer Awards. Comedy, starring Martin Clunes, James Buckley and Miles Jupp

programme.title: Hitpig!
programme.desc: A pig who works as a bounty hunter finds himself trekking the globe with a free-spirited elephant he intended to capture. Animated comedy, with the voices of Jason Sudeikis, Lilly Singh and Rainn Wilson

programme.title: The Fix
programme.desc: Disillusioned by the end of the war in Afghanistan, a group of disgraced, war torn ex-CIA operators set out to Tehran to take down a life-changing score. Thriller, starring Zachary Levi, Liam Neeson and Quincy Isaiah

programme.title: Better Man
programme.desc: Biographical drama charting the meteoric rise, dramatic fall and remarkable resurgence of British pop icon, Robbie Williams

programme.title: Mother's Pride
programme.desc: A grieving family who own a failing pub have their lives changed by brewing real ale and entering the Great British Beer Awards. Comedy, starring Martin Clunes, James Buckley and Miles Jupp

programme.title: Mexicali
programme.desc: Former fighter Joe helps run a Mexican farm with his partner, Estrella. After entering underground bouts to support the workers, he is ambushed by a gang and forced to fight for his life. Action thriller, starring Bren Foster and Tania Raymonde

programme.title: One Last Shot
programme.desc: Navy Seal Jake Harris must stop a team of mercenaries, led by his disillusioned former comrade, from disabling the US missile defense network. Director James Nunn's thriller, starring Scott Adkins, Steven Cree and Hannah Ware

programme.title: Cold Storage
programme.desc: When a lethal contagious fungus escapes a secret lab, two young employees, joined by a grizzled bioterror operative, must survive the wildest night shift ever. Director Jonny Campbell's comedy thriller, starring Joe Keery, Georgina Campbell, Liam Neeson and Lesley Manville

programme.title: Spider-Man: Into the Spider-Verse
programme.desc: Animated action adventure featuring the voices of Shameik Moore and Jake Johnson. Teenager Miles Morales is bitten by a radioactive arachnid and develops superhuman abilities like those of local hero Spider-Man. When Spidey is taken out of action by villain Kingpin, Miles must step up to prevent an unstable supercollider from sending New York into another dimension. But he soon finds he's not the only spider-being in town...

programme.title: Monster House
programme.desc: Animated comedy horror featuring the voices of Steve Buscemi, Maggie Gyllenhaal and Kathleen Turner. With Halloween approaching, three kids attempt to unlock a haunted house's dark secrets before it swallows up unsuspecting trick-or-treaters.

programme.title: The Cinema List: Animal Antics
programme.desc: Music and lights bring magic to life in this edition. From Sing to The Bad Guys 2, enjoy animated animal adventures the whole family will love

programme.title: Goat
programme.desc: A goat with big dreams gets a once-in-a-lifetime shot to join the pros and play roarball, a high-intensity sport dominated by the fiercest animals. Animated adventure, with the voices of Caleb McLaughlin and Gabrielle Union

programme.title: Tafiti - Across the Desert
programme.desc: A young meerkat's grandpa is bitten by a snake, so he sets off to find a magical flower for the cure. Animated adventure, featuring the voices of Cosima Henman, Steve Hudson and Kathleen Renish

programme.title: Wonder Park
programme.desc: Animated fantasy adventure featuring the voices of Brianna Denski, Jennifer Garner and Mila Kunis. June and her mother while away the hours playing with stuffed animals and imagining a fabulous theme park called "Wonderland". But when Mom is taken to hospital, June runs off into the woods and discovers the Wonderland characters living out a gloomy existence there. Can June make everything right again?

programme.title: Despicable Me
programme.desc: Animated comedy featuring the voice of Steve Carell. Behind the seemingly tranquil façade of small-town America, super-criminal Gru plots his biggest heist yet: to steal the Moon. But an encounter with orphan sisters Margo, Edith and Agnes proves that even the most dastardly villain has a soft centre.

programme.title: Despicable Me 2
programme.desc: Animated comedy sequel featuring the voices of Steve Carell and Kristen Wiig. The Anti-Villain League recruits former supervillain Gru to lead an investigation and find the person responsible for stealing a secret Arctic laboratory.

programme.title: Despicable Me 3
programme.desc: Animated comedy adventure featuring the voices of Steve Carell, Kristen Wiig and Trey Parker. Having already acquired a wife and three orphan daughters, reformed supervillain Gru now discovers that he has a long-lost twin, Dru. But Dru is hoping he can convince his brother to return to his wicked ways...

programme.title: Kung Fu Panda
programme.desc: Animated adventure featuring the voices of Jack Black, Dustin Hoffman and Angelina Jolie. Ancient China: Po the Panda lives in the Valley of Peace and dreams of becoming a kung fu master despite the fact he is clumsy, overweight and a complete beginner at martial arts. So when he's accidentally chosen to be the legendary Dragon Warrior, he is overjoyed. However, his joy is short-lived as the evil snow leopard Tai Lung has escaped from captivity and is on his way to the Valley to take his revenge on Po's mentor.

programme.title: Kung Fu Panda 2
programme.desc: Animated comedy adventure sequel with Jack Black as the voice of martial arts master Po. In order to stop the plot of evil peacock Lord Shen, Po must embark on a journey to discover the truth about his childhood.

programme.title: Kung Fu Panda 3
programme.desc: Animated comedy adventurel featuring the voices of Jack Black, Angelina Jolie and Dustin Hoffman. Dragon Warrior Po is forced to face his destiny when he discovers his long-lost father and comes up against a villain from the Spirit Realm, who is collecting the chi energy of all the kung fu masters.

programme.title: Hotel Transylvania
programme.desc: Animated comedy featuring the voices of Adam Sandler, Andy Samberg and Selena Gomez. Count Dracula is the gracious host at his daughter's 118th birthday party, which he's throwing at his own "five stake" resort for monsters. But he's less welcoming of a mortal backpacker who takes a shine to his precious girl.

programme.title: Hotel Transylvania 2
programme.desc: Animated horror comedy featuring the voices of Adam Sandler, Selena Gomez and Andy Samberg. Things have settled down at Dracula's hotel now that humans are allowed to stay. However, the Count can't help but worry that his half-human, half-vampire grandson Dennis isn't proving to be a chip off the old vampire block. So while Johnny and Mavis are away, Drac and his monster buddies decide to put Dennis through his paces.

programme.title: Hotel Transylvania 3: A Monster Vacation
programme.desc: Animated comedy horror featuring the voices of Adam Sandler, Selena Gomez and Andy Samberg. Exhausted from running the hotel, Count Dracula heads off on a sea cruise with the family. Romance beckons in the form of the ship's mysterious captain - but she is hiding a deadly secret that could spell disaster for the monsters.

programme.title: Wallace & Gromit in The Curse of the Were-Rabbit
programme.desc: Animated comedy adventure featuring the voices of Peter Sallis, Ralph Fiennes and Helena Bonham Carter. As the annual Giant Vegetable Competition approaches, enterprising Wallace and Gromit cash in with their humane pest-control outfit, "Anti-Pesto". But business turns sour when a huge, mysterious beast begins destroying every garden in the area.

programme.title: A Dog's Purpose
programme.desc: Fantasy adventure starring Britt Robertson and Dennis Quaid, and featuring the voice of Josh Gad. Young Ethan is devastated when his dog and best friend Bailey dies. But Bailey knows that it's not only cats that have nine lives.

programme.title: Look Who's Talking
programme.desc: Comedy with John Travolta and Kirstie Alley. Mollie is an accountant who has an affair with a married client and becomes pregnant. As the embryo develops it is strangely able to speak from its mother's womb. Later, when she goes into premature labour, a kind-hearted taxi driver comes to her aid.

programme.title: Look Who's Talking Too
programme.desc: Comedy sequel to the blockbuster Look Who's Talking, starring John Travolta and Kirstie Alley. Mikey is still trying to cope with the trials of potty training when he is presented with another bombshell: he is to get a sister. And, as if that wasn't enough, relations between his parents James and Mollie aren't going so well, either.

programme.title: The Cinema List: Animal Antics
programme.desc: Music and lights bring magic to life in this edition. From Sing to The Bad Guys 2, enjoy animated animal adventures the whole family will love

programme.title: Look Who's Talking Now
programme.desc: Comedy starring John Travolta and Kirstie Alley. With the children now able to walk and talk, the Ubriacco family acquire a mongrel puppy, Rocks. As the Christmas season approaches the family's usual struggles are complicated by the unexpected gift of Daphne, a pampered poodle.

programme.title: The Golden Compass
programme.desc: Fantasy adventure based on the first in Philip Pullman's His Dark Materials trilogy of novels, starring Nicole Kidman, Daniel Craig and Dakota Blue Richards. In a parallel universe where souls take animal form, orphan girl Lyra has been brought up among the scholars of Jordan College, Oxford. It is there she overhears her uncle, Lord Asriel, talk of a microscopic particle that can pass between different worlds.

programme.title: Goosebumps
programme.desc: Horror comedy based on the popular books by R L Stine, starring Jack Black. When 15-year-old Zach breaks into his neighbour's house to investigate strange noises, he discovers that he lives next door to the author of the Goosebumps series, whose monstrous creations have to be kept in locked manuscripts. But when the monsters get loose, it's up to Zach to help imprison them again.

programme.title: Goosebumps 2: Haunted Halloween
programme.desc: Two youngsters unwittingly unleash all manner of monsters from a locked manuscript they find in an abandoned house. Comedy sequel, starring Madison Iseman, Jeremy Ray Taylor and Wendy McLendon-Covey

programme.title: E.T.: The Extra-Terrestrial
programme.desc: Steven Spielberg's classic sci-fi adventure, starring Henry Thomas and Dee Wallace, and featuring Drew Barrymore. Ten-year-old Elliott has a new friend, but he's from another planet and nobody must know he's here.

programme.title: A Minecraft Movie
programme.desc: Four misfits are yanked through a strange portal into a cubic realm powered by imagination. To return home, they must learn its rules and journey alongside an unlikely master crafter. Director Jared Hess's blockbusting fantasy adventure based on the hit videogame, starring Jack Black, Jason Momoa, Emma Myers and Jennifer Coolidge

programme.title: Wicked: For Good
programme.desc: Elphaba, the Wicked Witch of the West, must reunite with Glinda the Good to transform herself - and Oz. Fantasy sequel based on the hit musical, starring Cynthia Erivo, Ariana Grande and Jeff Goldblum

programme.title: Bean
programme.desc: Comedy starring Rowan Atkinson as the accident-prone Mr Bean. In an attempt to get rid of him from his job as one of their attendants, the governors of the National Gallery send Mr Bean to America to represent them at the unveiling of the Grierson Gallery's new purchase. Needless to say disaster is never far away.

programme.title: Mr Bean's Holiday
programme.desc: Comedy starring Rowan Atkinson. Mr Bean puts the entente cordiale under considerable strain when he wins a camcorder and a trip to France in a raffle. After a typically accident-prone encounter with a Russian film director, the hapless hero ends up at the Cannes film festival.

programme.title: Peter Rabbit
programme.desc: Part-animated fantasy featuring the voice of James Corden, and starring Rose Byrne and Domhnall Gleeson. Peter Rabbit and his family take great pleasure in stealing vegetables from the garden of crotchety old Mr McGregor. But when the old man unexpectedly dies and his nephew inherits his home, Peter and co are confronted with a formidable new foe.

programme.title: Peter Rabbit 2: The Runaway
programme.desc: Part-animated fantasy featuring the voice of James Corden. Peter is now the star of Bea's children's book about his misadventures on Mr McGregor's farm. But when a new publisher comes on the scene, Peter finds himself being painted as a villain, and wonders if he'd be better off on his own.

programme.title: The Borrowers
programme.desc: Fantasy adventure starring John Goodman and Jim Broadbent. Pod, Homily and their children Peagreen and Arietty are the Borrowers, a family of tiny people living secretly in the house of young Pete. When Pete's Great Aunt Mary dies, no one can find the will and it looks as if the house may fall into the hands of nasty local lawyer, Ocious P Potter, and put the little family in danger.

programme.title: The Bourne Supremacy
programme.desc: Spy action thriller, the first sequel to The Bourne Identity, starring Matt Damon. Ex-CIA agent Jason Bourne, still suffering memory loss following an accident, finds his life in danger when he is implicated in the killing of an agent in Berlin.

programme.title: Shaft
programme.desc: Crime thriller starring Samuel L Jackson, Vanessa Williams, Jeffrey Wright and Christian Bale. Two years after a murder suspect skipped bail, detective John Shaft is given a second opportunity to get his man. But the path to justice is blocked by a ruthless drug baron intent on murdering the only witness to the crime.

programme.title: Juror #2
programme.desc: Magazine writer and family man Justin Kemp is sequestered to serve on the trial of James Sythe, who is accused of killing his girlfriend Kendall one year ago, following a fight in a bar. Justin faces an agonising moral dilemma - he was at the same pub as the defendant that fateful night, and struck something on the road during the drive home, which might have been Kendall. Clint Eastwood's legal thriller, starring Nicholas Hoult, Toni Collette, JK Simmons and Kiefer Sutherland

programme.title: The Last Stop in Yuma County
programme.desc: While stuck at a rural Arizona rest stop, a salesman is thrust into a hostage situation by the arrival of two ruthless bank robbers. Writer/director Francis Galluppi's crime thriller, starring Jim Cummings, Faizon Love and Jocelin Donahue

programme.title: Black Bag
programme.desc: When a spy is suspected of treason, her husband faces the ultimate test - loyalty to his marriage or his country. Director Steven Soderbergh's thriller, starring Michael Fassbender, Cate Blanchett and Rege-Jean Page

programme.title: Clear and Present Danger
programme.desc: Political thriller starring Harrison Ford and Willem Dafoe. When Jack Ryan is asked to investigate the murder of a friend of the US President, he finds himself up against not only a Colombian drugs cartel but also corrupt American government officials.

programme.title: The Equalizer
programme.desc: Crime thriller based on the hit US TV series, starring Denzel Washington. On the face of it, Robert McCall is just an ordinary guy who works at a DIY store and leads a quiet life. But when McCall befriends a young girl controlled by ruthless Russian gangsters, he's unable to stand idly by and resorts to using skills from his shady former career.

programme.title: The Equalizer 2
programme.desc: Crime thriller starring Denzel Washington and Pedro Pascal. Now living a peaceful life, former Marine and government agent Robert McCall offers his singular skills pro bono to those in need. However, when his friend is killed under suspicious circumstances, McCall investigates, and uses any means necessary to see justice served.

programme.title: Nightcrawler
programme.desc: Crime drama starring Jake Gyllenhaal, Rene Russo and Riz Ahmed. Los Angeles loner Louis Bloom makes a living hustling, until one night he observes a freelance news photographer taking photos of a horrific car accident. Inspired by this nocturnal, dog-eat-dog world of "nightcrawling", Bloom buys a video camera and spends his evenings in pursuit of accidents, robberies and fire scenes. However, as Bloom's scoops earn ever-more lucrative payment from local news stations, the line between reporting news and becoming part of it becomes dangerously blurred.

programme.title: The Bourne Ultimatum
programme.desc: Spy action thriller, starring Matt Damon, Julia Stiles and Joan Allen. When an article about a covert CIA operation appears in The Guardian, trained assassin Jason Bourne sets off for London to meet the journalist behind the exposé who may be able to shed light on Bourne's past. But his former employers are also on the trail with instructions to make sure that the meeting never happens.

programme.title: The Accountant
programme.desc: Crime drama starring Ben Affleck and Anna Kendrick. Unassuming accountant Christian Wolff struggles to balance his work for both criminal organisations and legitimate businesses, which draws him into a complex web of deception.

programme.title: Shaft
programme.desc: Crime thriller starring Samuel L Jackson, Vanessa Williams, Jeffrey Wright and Christian Bale. Two years after a murder suspect skipped bail, detective John Shaft is given a second opportunity to get his man. But the path to justice is blocked by a ruthless drug baron intent on murdering the only witness to the crime.

programme.title: The Girl on the Train
programme.desc: Mystery thriller based on the bestselling novel, starring Emily Blunt and Rebecca Ferguson. Divorce is made all the more painful for Rachel Watson because her morning commute takes her past the home where her ex-husband lives with his new wife. Rachel becomes curious about an attractive couple living close by, and her interest develops into an obsession when the woman is declared missing. Although convinced she may know something about the disappearance, Rachel's strained emotional state and a history of alcohol abuse make her story hard to believe.

programme.title: The World's End
programme.desc: Sci-fi comedy starring Simon Pegg and Nick Frost. Five old school friends reunite for an epic pub crawl in their home town and unwittingly become mankind's only hope for survival.

programme.title: Team America: World Police
programme.desc: Satirical comedy co-written, directed by and featuring the voices of South Park creators Trey Parker and Matt Stone, and performed by Thunderbirds-style puppets. A counter-terrorism squad causes havoc as it does battle with the Film Actors Guild and North Korean dictator Kim Jong Il, who is bent on destroying the civilised world.

programme.title: Logan Lucky
programme.desc: Comedy caper directed by Steven Soderbergh, starring Channing Tatum, Adam Driver and Daniel Craig. Two down-on-their-luck brothers decide to rob the Charlotte Motor Speedway in North Carolina. In order to pull off the job, they need the help of explosives expert Joe Bang - but first they must break him out of prison.

programme.title: Anchorman: The Legend of Ron Burgundy
programme.desc: Period comedy starring Will Ferrell. Ron Burgundy is the top newsreader at a San Diego TV station in the 1970s. But his position comes under threat with the arrival of ambitious reporter Veronica Corningstone. Male chauvinist Burgundy is torn between defending his job and his attraction to the glamorous newcomer.

programme.title: Beverly Hills Cop
programme.desc: Action comedy starring Eddie Murphy. An old friend's murder leads impulsive Detroit detective Axel Foley to glamorous Los Angeles in search of information about the killing. A law unto himself, Foley's streetwise attitude soon makes him enemies among the cops and the crooks.

programme.title: We're the Millers
programme.desc: Comedy starring Jennifer Aniston and Jason Sudeikis. In order to repay a debt to his drug supplier, small-time pot dealer David Clark agrees to smuggle a shipment of marijuana across the Mexican border. However, to carry out the deception, David recruits a stripper and two teenagers to pose as his family.

programme.title: Big Daddy
programme.desc: Comedy starring Adam Sandler. When his latest girlfriend dumps him because she says he is not a responsible adult, 32-year-old Sonny Koufax tries to win her back by adopting the illegitimate five-year-old son of his friend Kevin, who's on a trip to China.

programme.title: The Wedding Singer
programme.desc: Romantic comedy starring Adam Sandler and Drew Barrymore. Wedding singer Robbie Hart is usually the master of the big occasion, but when his own bride leaves him at the altar, his life - and performances - go to pieces. Then he meets Julia, who seems to be his perfect partner, but she's already engaged and wants Robbie to organise her wedding.

programme.title: Yesterday
programme.desc: Fantasy comedy starring Himesh Patel and Lily James. Cycling home after a gig, aspiring musician Jack is hit by a bus during a strange power cut. He wakes up to find himself in a world where nobody has heard of the Beatles, so takes advantage of this by passing their songs off as his own. Success soon comes his way, but it threatens to come between him and his manager and best friend, Ellie.

programme.title: Mother's Pride
programme.desc: A grieving family who own a failing pub have their lives changed by brewing real ale and entering the Great British Beer Awards. Comedy, starring Martin Clunes, James Buckley and Miles Jupp

programme.title: Bridesmaids
programme.desc: Comedy starring Kristen Wiig and Rose Byrne. After Lillian announces her engagement, she asks her lifelong pal Annie to be her maid of honour. However, Annie's life is in a mess, and she finds herself losing control over the bachelorette party to Lillian's seemingly perfect new friend Helen.

programme.title: Anchorman 2: The Legend Continues
programme.desc: Comedy sequel starring Will Ferrell and Steve Carell. After a disastrous move to New York in which he became estranged from his co-anchor wife and was fired from his job, anchorman Ron Burgundy is hired by a ruthless network executive to work the graveyard shift on the world's first 24-hour rolling news channel.

programme.title: Bridget Jones: Mad About the Boy
programme.desc: Romantic comedy sequel starring Renée Zellweger, Hugh Grant and Chiwetel Ejiofor. Still mourning the tragic death of her husband, Bridget Jones starts a fresh chapter as a single mum. With the support of some old friends, including old flame Daniel Cleaver, she re-enters the world of dating, while also clashing with her son's dashing but uptight science teacher, Scott Wallaker.

programme.title: Marmaduke
programme.desc: Canine comedy featuring the voice of Owen Wilson. When the family of irrepressible Great Dane Marmaduke moves to a new home in California, it all proves to be something of a culture shock for the hapless hound, who continues to wreak havoc wherever he goes.

programme.title: xXx
programme.desc: Spy action thriller starring Vin Diesel as extreme-sports fanatic Xander Cage, who is coerced by the US government into infiltrating a Prague-based terrorist organisation when he falls foul of the law.

programme.title: 300: Rise of an Empire
programme.desc: Ruler of the Persian empire and self-proclaimed god Xerxes continues his campaign to crush the emerging Greek nation, forcing a general from the democratic city state of Athens to lead his navy into battle against Xerxes' vast armada. Fantasy adventure sequel, starring Sullivan Stapleton, Eva Green and Lena Headey

programme.title: Godzilla
programme.desc: Monster horror starring Matthew Broderick and Jean Reno. When a Japanese vessel is sunk in the South Pacific and enormous footprints are discovered in Panama, a team of scientists is brought in to investigate. But radiation expert Niko Tatopoulos has his own theory - nuclear bomb tests have mutated a lizard to gigantic proportions and Manhattan is now under threat.

programme.title: The Scorpion King
programme.desc: Action adventure fantasy starring The Rock. In ancient times, powerful warrior Memnon presides over the desert with the aid of sorceress Cassandra. In an attempt to bring down this mighty duo, the assassin Mathayus is hired to kill Cassandra and thereafter become king of the last free tribes.

programme.title: Transformers
programme.desc: Sci-fi action adventure from director Michael Bay, starring Shia LaBeouf and Megan Fox. Unsuspecting teenager Sam Witwicky holds the key to the survival of the human race when alien enemies the Autobots and the Decepticons arrive on Earth and continue their war.

programme.title: Transformers: Revenge of the Fallen
programme.desc: Sci-fi action sequel starring Shia LaBeouf and Megan Fox. The ancient history of the Transformers' presence on Earth is revealed as the human race battles the first ever Decepticon, and once again Sam Witwicky is in the thick of the action.

programme.title: Transformers: Dark of the Moon
programme.desc: Sci-fi adventure starring Shia LaBeouf. Sam Witwicky and the Autobots must spring back into action when a Decepticon, secretly planted on the Moon in the 1960s, becomes a clear and present danger. Not only is the technology contained within it potentially devastating to humankind, but Sam is also dealing with relationship problems.

programme.title: Transformers: Age of Extinction
programme.desc: Sci-fi action adventure starring Mark Wahlberg. Four years after the Battle of Chicago, the Autobots are now in hiding from the US government after being deemed a threat to humanity. So when struggling engineer Cade Yeager comes across an old semi truck while looking for parts, he soon finds himself on the radar of government forces and an alien bounty hunter.

programme.title: Transformers: The Last Knight
programme.desc: Sci-fi action adventure starring Mark Wahlberg and Anthony Hopkins. When Optimus Prime returns to what is left of Cybertron, he is brainwashed by seductive leader Quintessa to return to Earth to obtain a mystical staff belonging to Merlin which will bring his home planet back to life.

programme.title: Aquaman
programme.desc: Action fantasy starring Jason Momoa, Amber Heard and Nicole Kidman. Arthur Curry (aka Aquaman), the half-human heir to the throne of Atlantis, has long since rejected his underwater brethren. But when his half-brother and current king Orm plots to destroy the surface world, Arthur is drawn into a quest to unite the marine realms and save humanity.

programme.title: Supergirl
programme.desc: The Kryptonian heroine joins forces with an unlikely companion on an interstellar journey of vengeance and justice when an unexpected adversary strikes close to home. Fantasy adventure, starring Milly Alcock, David Corenswet and Jason Momoa

programme.title: Bad Boys for Life
programme.desc: Comedy thriller starring Will Smith and Martin Lawrence. When a figure from the past returns and targets detective Mike Lowery for assassination, he and partner Marcus Burnett are forced to fight back - curtailing Burnett's retirement plans. But things aren't all they seem, and it gradually becomes clear that Lowery may have an even deeper connection with their assailant.

programme.title: Evil Dead Rise
programme.desc: Guitar technician Beth abandons life on tour to visit her estranged sister Ellie and three children, Bridget, Danny and Kassie. A 5.5 magnitude earthquake rocks the city, causing structural failures in the basement that expose an old bank vault and a copy of the Naturom Demonto. Horror, starring Alyssa Sutherland

programme.title: From Dusk Till Dawn 2: Texas Blood Money
programme.desc: A bank robber is bitten by a vampire, spelling trouble for his partners in crime, who find themselves trapped in their hideout with a bloodsucking terror. Horror sequel, starring Robert Patrick, Bo Hopkins, Duane Whitaker, Muse Watson and Tiffani-Amber Thiessen

programme.title: Pet Sematary
programme.desc: Supernatural horror based on Stephen King's novel, starring Jason Clarke, Amy Seimetz and John Lithgow. Shortly after the Creed family move to a new town, their cat is killed in a traffic accident. Neighbour Jud suggests they lay the animal to rest in an ancient woodland burial ground. When the family is rocked by tragedy, though, events take a macabre turn.

programme.title: The Cinema List: Revenge
programme.desc: Some films are best served cold, so wrap up and join us as we dive into our favourite revenge movies - from new hits to Oscar-winning classics. We hope you're ready for action.

programme.title: Wolf Man
programme.desc: After a family barricade themselves inside their remote farmhouse when a creature attacks, a father slowly transforms into something unrecognisable. Werewolf horror from The Invisible Man director Leigh Whannell, starring Christopher Abbott, Julia Garner, Matilda Firth and Sam Jaeger

programme.title: It
programme.desc: Horror starring Jaeden Lieberher, Bill Skarsgård and Finn Wolfhard. In the summer of 1989, seven misfit children come together to investigate a series of mysterious tragedies in their town, and find themselves facing off against a demon that takes the shape of a terrifying clown.

programme.title: Five Nights At Freddy's 2
programme.desc: One year after the supernatural nightmare at Freddy Fazbear's Pizza, Mike and Vanessa are pulled back into a terrifying series of events. Horror sequel, starring Josh Hutcherson and Elizabeth Lail

programme.title: Get Out
programme.desc: Oscar-winning horror mystery starring Daniel Kaluuya and Allison Williams. Chris, a young African-American photographer, is understandably anxious when he's invited to stay with his wealthy white girlfriend's parents at their family estate. Admitting she hasn't told them he's black only adds to Chris's apprehension, but mum and dad are warm and welcoming. However, as the weekend unfolds, Chris begins to suspect all is not as it seems.

programme.title: The Bride!
programme.desc: In 1930s Chicago, maverick scientist Dr Euphronius gives life to a murdered woman, sparking romance, police interest and radical change. Writer/director Maggie Gyllenhaal's horror based on The Bride of Frankenstein, starring Jessie Buckley, Christian Bale and Annette Bening

programme.title: The Conjuring: Last Rites
programme.desc: Paranormal investigators Ed and Lorraine Warren take on one last terrifying case involving mysterious entities they must confront. Supernatural mystery drama, starring Vera Farmiga, Patrick Wilson and Elliot Cowan

programme.title: The Shining
programme.desc: Stanley Kubrick's chilling horror, starring Jack Nicholson and Shelley Duvall. Aspiring writer and recovering alcoholic Jack Torrance takes on the job of winter caretaker at the remote Overlook Hotel, despite a warning about the psychological strain the long months of isolation can cause. Jack's wife Wendy only hopes that Jack will finally find the time to write, but his psychically gifted son Danny has visions of a terrifying ordeal for the family.

programme.title: Halloween Ends
programme.desc: Horror sequel starring Jamie Lee Curtis, James Jude Courtney and Nick Castle. Psychopath Michael Myers has been incarcerated for 40 years, following his killing spree in small-town Haddonfield. Living in fear of Myers's possible return, survivor Laurie Strode has turned her home into a fortress and prepared her sceptical family for the worst. When Myers escapes, the stage is set for a showdown.

programme.title: 28 Years Later: The Bone Temple
programme.desc: Dr Kelson finds himself in a shocking new relationship with consequences that could change the world as he knows it. Horror sequel, starring Ralph Fiennes, Jack O'Connell and Alfie Williams

programme.title: Reporting Scotland: News at Seven
programme.desc: Reports from BBC newsrooms across the country with analysis and discussion on the big stories of the day

programme.title: Sportscene: Premiership Highlights
programme.desc: Action from the latest matches, featuring Motherwell v Celtic at Fir Park Stadium and Aberdeen v St Johnstone at Pittodrie

programme.title: Pilgrimage: The Road to the Scottish Isles
programme.desc: The pilgrims head north-east to Moray on the edge of the Highlands and their first stop is Pluscarden Abbey, Britain's only working medieval monastery. Keen to see how these current day Benedictine monks live and work, the pilgrims stay overnight, and sample some of the routines of monastic life, which includes helping with domestic duties

programme.title: Highland Cops
programme.desc: Torrential rain from two winter storms leads to flooded roads and fields, with police searching for a missing person in treacherous conditions. When they learn there is a warrant out for the man's arrest and he has skipped a court appearance, the search turns into an urgent manhunt across a dark and flooded landscape. Meanwhile, thieves have been on the rampage throughout Inverness and response officers Mo and Nathan are called in to track them down

programme.title: Still Game

programme.title: Scot Squad
programme.desc: Chief Miekelson struggles to remain professional when the independent remuneration committee decide on his new salary, Karen takes part in a revolutionary experiment that involves officers meeting the public on their own turf and Archie Pepper captures harnesses smart technology to capture Scotland's dumbest crooks

programme.title: Breaking the News
programme.desc: Des Clarke returns with the topical comedy news quiz, with panellists Tiffany Stevenson, Rosco McClelland, Amanda Dwyer and Chris Forbes taking a satirical swipe at the week's news agenda in Scotland, the UK and around the world

programme.title: The Sunday Show
programme.desc: Gary Robertson presents a look at the main issues from the world of politics and beyond, featuring interviews, discussion and analysis on the stories that matter to Scotland

programme.title: The Green Mile
programme.desc: Fantasy prison drama based on the novel by Stephen King, starring Tom Hanks and featuring Michael Clarke Duncan. Retired warder Paul Edgecomb remembers his time in charge of death-row inmates in a Louisiana penitentiary, and the strange powers of convicted child killer John Coffey.

programme.title: Empire of the Sun
programme.desc: Second World War drama based on the novel by JG Ballard, starring Christian Bale and John Malkovich. When the Imperial Japanese army marches into Shanghai in December 1941, the privileged life 11-year-old Jim Graham enjoys with his family in the city's International Settlement comes to an end. In the ensuing turmoil, Jim is separated from his parents.

programme.desc: Mild-mannered war veteran Lee Walker plans a life of quiet domesticity in California with his wife Muriel and younger brother Julius. Restless after an early discharge from the US Army, Julius steals money from Lee to seek his fortune in Nevada, where he lands a job in security at a casino and sparks forbidden desire with co-worker Henry, which is consummated away from prying eyes. Back in their hotel room, Julius and Henry fantasise about using the same underhand tactics as card sharps to line their pockets. Drama, starring Daisy Edgar-Jones, Jacob Elordi and Will Poulter

programme.desc: Epic drama starring Brad Pitt, Anthony Hopkins and Aidan Quinn. Three brothers, Alfred, Samuel and Tristan, are raised by their ex-cavalry father on a remote ranch near the Montana Rockies. Their lifestyle is irreversibly changed when Samuel brings home his beautiful fiancée, Susannah, and the brothers decide to join the army to fight in the First World War.

programme.title: Valentine's Day
programme.desc: Romantic comedy featuring an ensemble cast including Anne Hathaway, Jessica Alba and Julia Roberts. The love life of a florist working on Valentine's Day is sent into a tailspin after he proposes to his girlfriend. Meanwhile, his best friend thinks she has met the man of her dreams, little realising he is already married. Will love lend a hand and save the day?

programme.title: Grease
programme.desc: Musical based on the hit stage show, starring John Travolta and Olivia Newton-John. Unexpectedly reunited with summer love Danny at her new high school, Sandy Olsson can't believe how different he is. Can the new Danny Zuko, the leather-clad, tough-talking leader of the T-birds, really be the boy she met down at the beach? Perhaps Frenchy and Rizzo, both members of the super-cool Pink Ladies gang, can help her develop some street cred to win back his heart.

programme.title: The Bodyguard
programme.desc: Romantic thriller starring Kevin Costner and Whitney Houston. Bodyguard and former secret serviceman Frank Farmer, still haunted by the assassination attempt on President Reagan, is asked to safeguard superstar singer and actress Rachel Marron who has been receiving death threats. But when Farmer visits Marron's luxurious home he is met with resentment from the singer and those around her.

Years after the collapse of his political revolutionary group, Bob Ferguson lives in paranoid seclusion with his teenage daughter, Willa. But the merciless Colonel Lockjaw, a one-time target of Bob's group, has been hunting its members ever since, and has unfinished business with Bob.

programme.title: Lee
programme.desc: Biographical drama starring Kate Winslet. As the Second World War rages, American fashion model-turned-photographer Elizabeth "Lee" Miller defies the expectations of the era and travels to mainland Europe as a war correspondent for Vogue. Reporting from the frontline, Miller captures indelible images of the conflict, including the horrors found in the Nazi concentration camps at Buchenwald and Dachau.

programme.title: Downton Abbey: The Grand Finale
programme.desc: In the summer of 1930, the Crawleys grapple with the threat of social disgrace when Mary finds herself at the centre of a public scandal. Romantic drama, starring Joely Richardson, Joanne Froggatt and Paul Giamatti

programme.title: Footloose

programme.title: Kindergarten Cop

The breathless life of young singles in Chicago is the pattern for Danny and Bernie - fast women, late nights and tall stories fill the noisy, boozy evenings after a hard or not-so-hard day's work. Buddies of a feather, for ever, or so it seems, until Danny falls in love.

Playboy Arthur Bach spends money like water and drinks like a fish, and will flush his chances of inheritance down the drain unless he marries a respectable heiress. The "good people" of Mayfield Place are determined to discover the hideous truth.

The two are soon married, but not happily so, and on a trip to Vienna he falls in love with a disembodied brain.

programme.desc: A poet has a history of ruining relationships owing to his paranoia, but when he meets the woman of his dreams, he resolves to make this romance last. The daft duo embark on a variety of adventures before discovering the briefcase is full of dollar bills.

programme.desc: Dermot O'Leary heads to the west of Co Donegal for a crash course in the Irish language at Glencolmcille Folk Village, before putting his lesson to the test by ordering a pint in a local pub. programme.title: Clodagh: Cooking at Home
programme.desc: Irish chef and author Clodagh McKenna demonstrates the recipes that she loves to cook, beginning with four of her favourite one-pan dishes . She makes broccoli salmon noodles and an all-in-one spicy sausage pasta, and shares the tricks to make her pear, thyme and brie tart. She then picks greens from the garden to go in a big warming pot of walled garden soup that she makes in her pickling shed to share with her husband Harry Herbert

programme.title: Fletchers' Family Farm
programme.desc: Return of the documentary following Kelvin Fletcher and his family, joining them as they adjust to life in their lodge and living back on their land. Lambing gets underway and, after a tricky start, the ewes are producing some of the biggest and healthiest lambs they've ever had

programme.title: The Voice UK
programme.desc: Emma Willis hosts as the battle rounds begin, with coaches Tom Jones, Will.i.am, Kelly Rowland, Tom Fletcher and Danny Jones putting their teams through the toughest challenge yet. Joined by special guest mentors, the coaches prepare their artists for a series of head-to-head performances before making the difficult decision of which three singers from each team will progress to the semi-final.

With analysis from Matt Taylor and Francis Benali, commentary by Joe Speight and Iain Dowie, and reports from Katie Shanahan

programme.title: Top of the Pops: The Story of 1976
programme.desc: Documentary examining how the BBC's flagship pop show reflected changes in British music and culture during 1976. As the popularity of glam rock faded, no dominant musical scene emerged to replace it, leading to chart success for bands including Abba, Showaddywaddy, the Brotherhood of Man and the Wurzels - while outside the mainstream, punk rock was rapidly growing in popularity. Featuring contributions by Tony Blackburn, Paul Morley, Toyah Willcox, David Hamilton and Dave Haslam

programme.title: Brief History of a Family
programme.desc: Mystery drama starring Lin Muran and Sun Xilun. After an incident at school, outgoing teenager Wei brings home his quiet classmate Shuo, and a friendship begins. However, as Wei and his parents get to know Shuo, the newcomer's presence has an unexpected effect on their comfortable lives.

programme.title: Countryfile
programme.desc: Matt Baker and Emily McGowen are in the Cotswolds for the biggest date in the sheepdog trialling calendar - the Supreme. The finest dogs and handlers from across the UK and Ireland take part in a showcase of instinct, skill and control. After months of training and a year of tough qualifying trials, only one will claim the title of Supreme Champion

programme.title: BBC News
programme.desc: A round-up of the latest headlines

programme.title: Landward
programme.desc: Dougie Vipond is in Easter Ross on the shores of the Cromarty Firth to meet a couple with a seed-growing business in the area's fertile farmland. Cammy Wilson is in Angus to hearing how award-winning beef famers made the switch back to native cattle for better results, while Rachel Bell continues her journey round the Buchan coast and has a lesson in making fishing nets, and Arlene Stuart heads to Jura to find out how three women are making a living and living their dream.

programme.title: The Best of Weatherman Walking
programme.desc: Derek Brockway revisits choice moments from his travels. In Cardigan Bay, he discovers the legend of Cantre'r Gwaelod at Sarn Cynfelyna and has a go at stand-up paddle-boarding, before finishing at Aberystwyth. In Ceredigion, he walks from Bwlch yr Arian, where he feeds red kites, to Devil's Bridge, famed for its three stacked bridges. Finally, Derek follows the course of the River Teifi between Cenarth and Cilgerran where he learns to steer a coracle, the area's ancient form of fishing boat, and takes part in the annual coracle races

programme.title: Saturday Kitchen Best Bites
programme.desc: Matt Tebbutt presents more highlights, with recipes by Mike Reid, Donna Hay and Shivi Ramoutar, while actor Stanley Tucci tucks into a choice between two of his food heavens

programme.title: Eva Longoria: Searching for France
programme.desc: The actress explores the history, food and culture of Provence, starting in the port city of Marseilles. She shares a spicy 'half-and-half' pizza with local chef and rising star Valentin Ruffali before heading to La Ola to try a delicious blend of French and North African cuisine courtesy of chef Khouloude Ben Thayer. Eva then heads out into the sun-kissed landscape to try the traditional summer vegetable dish of ratatouille and a sun-drenched salad niçoise on the Riviera at the famous Hotel du Cap

programme.title: Nigel and Adam's Farm Kitchen
programme.desc: Nigel Slater and Adam Henson look at heritage foods - the old favourites still on people's shopping lists today, revealing that the way they are cooked and who eats them has changed over the years. They focus on pork which, counting all the different types - from ham to bacon and sausages - makes it the most popular choice of meat in the world. To discover how farmers meet demand, they rear three breeds of pig, and Adam takes the produce to market, with profits going to Children in Need

programme.title: The Ipcress File
programme.desc: Spy thriller starring Michael Caine. Intelligence agent Harry Palmer is plunged into the shabby and treacherous world of counter-espionage as he uncovers a bizarre "brain drain" among scientists. Nobody can be trusted and nothing is what it seems.

programme.title: Funeral in Berlin
programme.desc: Spy drama starring Michael Caine as secret agent Harry Palmer. When British intelligence receives news that a high-ranking Russian agent is keen to defect to the West, Palmer is sent to Berlin to meet him, but matters are complicated by the intervention of the Israeli secret service.

programme.title: This Farming Life
programme.desc: As a new year begins, Carianne and her brother-in-law Alexander take Faillish the bull to the Oban Highland Show, hoping to bag a rosette and sell him for a good price. In Inverkip, the time has come for Rachel and Camy to scan their ewes to see how many are pregnant - a big moment of truth for their fledgling breeding programme - and in South Ayrshire, the Barclays are up early to start lambing

programme.title: Flog It!
programme.desc: Antiques experts Thomas Plant and Claire Rawle search for valuable items at Leicester's De Montfort Hall, and presenter Paul Martin discovers a collection of Picasso ceramics curated by Richard Attenborough

programme.title: Celebrity Antiques Road Trip
programme.desc: Presenter and broadcaster Moira Stuart and star of the stage and screen Aled Jones face off in a battle of antiques in Kent. They're joined by experts David Harper and Serhat Ahmet. Moira shocks and surprises David with her eclectic, unorthodox choices and haggling tactics. Aled and Serhat find common ground with sport and music

programme.title: Eva Longoria: Searching for France
programme.desc: The actress explores the history, food and culture of Bordeaux, finding out its world-famous vineyards are undergoing a revival as vintners seek to update their wines by introducing new technology and reinventing older traditions. She visits St Emillion, where wine production began 1,000 years ago, and enjoys unusual wine pairings by sampling a deep red with fish, and a buttery white with cheese

programme.title: Pilgrimage: The Road Through North Wales
programme.desc: On the final stage of their journey, the travellers start just outside Eryri national park. They head west towards the Llyn Peninsula and the village of Y Fron in the famous North Wales slate landscape. Tom Rosenthal and Spencer Matthews join Sonali Shah on a 24-hour fast to celebrate the start of Paryushana, the holiest festival in the Jain calendar. The last leg of their journey takes the pilgrims along the spectacular North Wales coast path

programme.title: Wilderness with Simon Reeve
programme.desc: Simon journeys deep into Canada's vast and empty Yukon Territory, one of North America's most remote landscapes. Covering an area almost the size of Spain but home to fewer than 50,000 people, the Yukon is a land of immense forests, glaciers, rivers and wildlife. Simon wants to find out how the people and the wildlife of this immense wilderness are faring, all while searching for grizzly bears

programme.title: Later... with Jools Holland
programme.desc: Jools returns to Alexandra Palace Theatre in north London for the 69th run of the show, introducing performances by Paul Heaton, Skye Newman, DC3, Mary in the Junkyard and Dermot Henry. He also chats to former Smiths guitarist Johnny Marr about his new album The Age of Everything and a recent auction that saw him sell more than 80 guitars from his near 45-year career.

programme.title: Don't Look Now
programme.desc: Nicolas Roeg's supernatural thriller, adapted from Daphne du Maurier's short story, starring Donald Sutherland and Julie Christie. Following the tragic drowning of their young daughter, John and Laura Baxter go to Venice - he to work, she to recuperate. There they meet two sisters, one of whom claims to be able to communicate with the dead child. Caught up in the bizarre events that follow, the Baxters are drawn inexorably toward a mysterious and forbidding fate.

programme.title: The Simpsons

programme.title: The Simpsons
programme.desc: Homer becomes an internet recapper while Krusty joins the circus.

programme.title: The Simpsons
programme.desc: A $600 theft rocks the Simpson home. A local TV crime show attempts to crack it to no avail.

programme.title: The Simpsons
programme.desc: Homer fakes his own death to avoid work and ends up meeting his long-lost mother - but Bart and Lisa begin to suspect their new-found granny is keeping something from them. Featuring the guest voices of Glenn Close and Harry Morgan

programme.title: The Simpsons
programme.desc: Homer and Marge are accused of being bad parents and sent to a special class to resolve the problem, resulting in Bart, Lisa and Maggie being placed in the care of Ned Flanders - who promptly decides to have them baptised

programme.title: Sunday Brunch
programme.desc: Highlights of the chat and cookery show, with Tim Lovejoy and Simon Rimmer

programme.desc: TV presenter Anneka Rice and pop star Cheryl Baker go head to head as they each create a pair of leather earrings in the timed challenge, and TV personality Jo Wood takes on broadcaster Natasha Kaplinsky in a pyrography craft-off

programme.title: Couples Come Dine with Me
programme.desc: In Nottinghamshire, Nena and her husband Vish kick off the competition with an Indian feast. Gym-loving guests Syreeta and Romaine are worried the food will be too spicy, while final couple Paul and wife Vicki think the menu is nothing special. Day two sees Syreeta and laid-back Romaine host an evening. The post-meal planking contest proves a hit, but Romaine's romantic crooning hits a bum note. Finally it's the turn of Vicki and her husband Paul to try to see off the competition and bag themselves the £1,000 prize

programme.title: Cheers
programme.desc: Sam drafts Woody onto the bowling team to play against Gary's Olde Towne Tavern, only to discover all his regulars are hopelessly poor at the game - prompting Diane to step in and save the day for the Cheers gang. Comedy, starring Ted Danson

programme.title: Cheers
programme.desc: Cliff is thrilled to meet his estranged father, but their reunion does not go to plan, and Sam's date proves to be a bone of contention between him and Diane. Comedy, starring John Ratzenberger and Ted Danson

programme.title: Cheers
programme.desc: Sam is used as the subject of Diane's research paper.

programme.title: Cheers
programme.desc: Woody wins several weekly football pools at Cheers and decides to gamble everything on a large bet - but Sam tries to discourage him. Meanwhile, Frasier and Diane's constant bickering has the gang climbing the walls. Comedy, starring Ted Danson

programme.title: Everybody Loves Raymond
programme.desc: When Robert asks if he can borrow the suitcase sitting on the stairway landing, Ray explains he and Debra have been locked in a two-week battle of wills over who is responsible for putting the item away. Ray Romano and Brad Garrett star

programme.title: Everybody Loves Raymond
programme.desc: Debra and Marie give Raymond a guilt trip when they find out that the bachelor party he hosted for Robert was a huge disappointment. After playing cards and eating pizza at Robert's apartment, Ray is forced to leave the party early and Debra, who is surprised that Ray is home so early, informs him that he dropped the ball and really let his brother down. Debra suggests Ray host a "real" bachelo...

programme.title: Frasier
programme.desc: Martin prepares to celebrate his birthday, but an argument between Niles and Frasier over a patient, as well as a city-wide power cut, ensures none of the household is in the mood for a party. Kelsey Grammer and David Hyde Pierce star

programme.title: Frasier
programme.desc: The radio station's new manager disagrees with everything Frasier says - and when the shrink objects to her ideas, he finds his show rescheduled at two o'clock in the morning. Comedy, guest starring Mercedes Ruehl, with Kelsey Grammer

programme.title: Sunday Brunch
programme.desc: Tim Lovejoy and Simon Rimmer chat to Lee Mack, Russell T Davies, Sarah Solemani, Emma Sidi and KayCee Stroh, with music by Everyone Says Hi

programme.title: The Simpsons
programme.desc: Homer doesn't seem to care when Santa's Little Helper goes missing, puzzling the rest of his family who are all panicking about their missing pooch. So Grampa shares a story about his son, a certain childhood pet and a more youthful but no-less-bitter Mr Burns

programme.title: The Simpsons
programme.desc: Homer deliberately puts on weight so he can qualify as disabled and start working from home - but it is not long before he discovers the disadvantages of being his own boss

programme.title: The Dog House
programme.desc: Documentary set inside Woodgreen animal charity, following staff who are committed to matching their homeless dogs with prospective owners. Bulldog Commander Rockerfella - aka Rocky - is sporting a new look for his meeting, after a much-needed facelift. Dafne the sausage dog is pining after losing her human soulmate - and is not sold on plucky papillon cross Woody's moves to impress her. Muddy puddle enthusiast Grady the lurcher is always looking for her next thrill, however Woodgreen staff think that adventure seeker Denise could be the perfect match

programme.title: George Clarke's Amazing Spaces
programme.desc: A Nottingham couple cement their relationship with an ambitious floating home, while in London George discovers an explosion of global architecture in a tiny one-bedroom flat. In Lincolnshire, family relations are put to the test as two teenage siblings take on the task of building their own mobile homes away from home. Plus, together with master craftsman Will Hardie, George conjures up a magical 30-mile vista in a wall just 20cm thick in their secret garden studio flat

programme.title: Worst House on the Street
programme.desc: Stuart and Scarlette help Colin and Audrey, whose five-bed Balham home needs a complete overhaul to be in with any chance of appealing to a modern-day family

programme.title: Channel 4 News
programme.desc: Including sport and weather

programme.desc: Lee McKenzie presents action from the 17th round of the season, held at Marina Bay Street Circuit. George Russell of Mercedes was the victorious driver last year, with Red Bull's Max Verstappen finishing second and eventual champion Lando Norris of McLaren taking third place. With analysis from David Coulthard and Billy Monger

programme.title: The Great Celebrity Pottery Throw Down
programme.desc: Liza Tarbuck hosts the final, which sees the top four celebrities getting their hands dirty in a bid for the title. They are asked to create a dessert trifle set comprising serving bowls, spoon and a small jug, and sit at the wheels one last time to take on a tricky throw in the surprise challenge. Rich Miller and Keith Brymer Jones judge their efforts before crowning the winner

Next, Sue Lewis from Sue's B&B seeks to discover the deasons for Callum and Lauren's low score for the cleanliness. When all issues are resolved, the winning establishment is revealed

programme.title: 999: On the Front Line
programme.desc: A man's heart has stopped beating, not once but twice. The paramedics manage to bring him back to life before rushing him to resus. A patient needs an emergency stop to empty her bladder, a man can't get out of his armchair and has severe pain in his knee, and a patient has extreme fatigue and abdominal pain

programme.title: 24 Hours in A&E
programme.desc: Forty-nine-year-old Nasly is brought into A&E with DKA, a life-threatening complication of diabetes, and Charlie, 72, has severe chest and back pains, although his complicated medical history proves a challenge for the medics. Emergency nurse practitioner Alison is on a busy shift, while explaining how her parents' life in Iran, and the struggles they faced during the revolution, influenced her to get into medicine

programme.title: 24 Hours in A&E
programme.desc: The staff at St George's Hospital in south-west London treat patients from three different generations. Leo is in A&E after crashing his car and flipping it on its roof. Leo's husband JR tells the story of how the two men met and how some members of their family struggled to accept their marriage. Meanwhile, young Kieran has hurt his wrist tumbling off his skateboard and 91-year-old Lillian has fallen over at home

programme.title: Shark Attack Files
programme.desc: There's mere seconds between life and death during a shark attack. Everyone, from beachgoers to seasoned divers, must use every trick up their sleeve to avoid these apex predators' clutches. A mix of never-before-seen footage, heart-pounding recreations and insightful testimonials will explore the most astounding shark attacks from the last several years - and how each victim fought back.

programme.title: Africa's Deadliest
programme.desc: Africa's Deadliest: Opportunists. When it comes to sinking their teeth into an easy meal, Africa's predators must use all of their cunning and brazenness to bag a catch. Sometimes they rely on strategy or brute strength, sometimes it's pure luck. Either way, when Mother Nature presents Africa's greatest hunters with an opportunity, they must be ready to spring into action with jaws and claws bared.

programme.title: Africa's Deadliest
programme.desc: Africa's Deadliest: River Rivals. The rivers of Africa - long held in myth and legend for the life they bring and the monsters they hide. programme.title: Hitler's Last Stand
programme.desc: In October 1944, a regiment of segregated Japanese American soldiers fights to rescue an encircled US battalion in the steep, booby-trapped forests of the Vosges mountains. With the Nazis closing in and supplies running out, the Nisei soldiers push the limits to reach their brothers-in-arms. It will take more than fifty years for their valor to be fully acknowledged.

programme.title: Hitler's Last Stand
programme.desc: As Christmas 1944 nears, Nazi Panzer forces sweep through Belgium as they drive to recapture the port city of Antwerp. At westernmost edge of the famous Bulge, American paratroopers of the 517th Parachute Infantry Regiment fight fiercely to reverse the breakthrough. During the fighting, a young US scout becomes separated from his regiment and spends the night trapped behind the enemy line.

programme.title: Air Crash Investigation
programme.desc: Sichuan Airlines Flight 8633 is high above the Himalayas when the cockpit window cracks and suddenly explodes. Amid the violent decompression, the first officer is sucked half way out the window. And-flying solo-the captain somehow battles gale-force winds, glacial temperatures, and oxygen deprivation to heroically land the plane. Then it's up to investigators to figure out what went wrong.

programme.title: Air Crash Investigation
programme.desc: En route to Sydney from a remote lodge, a UK billionaire and his family board a doomed Australian seaplane. Moments after takeoff, the single-engine aircraft nosedives into Jerusalem Bay. Perplexed investigators can't find anything wrong with the plane or the pilot. That is, until the wreckage reveals a minor maintenance issue with deadly consequences.

programme.title: Air Crash Investigation
programme.desc: A Bulgarian airliner is en route to the Black Sea resort town of Varna when four violent hijackers take hostages and demand to be flown to Vienna-even though there isn't enough fuel on board for the two-hour detour. Conspiring with authorities on the ground, the crew comes up with a daring plan to press on. But can they somehow fool the hijackers into believing that Varna is Vienna?

programme.title: How the Tudors Lost Their Heads
programme.desc: Margaret Pole was born into England's ruling dynasty but lost her wealth and status when the Tudors came to power. Resilient and smart, she fought her way back to become one of the country's most powerful people. She was trusted by Henry VIII to be his daughter Mary's governess but was also willing to defy the king. Suzannah Lipscomb and Dan Snow trace Margaret's incredible story and investigate her downfall, exploring castles across England and heading to Europe on the trail of her son, Reginald. A protégé of Henry VIII, he turned against the king over the break with Catholic Rome. Reginald's 'betrayal' led to an international manhunt that endangered his family and eventually led to Margaret's conviction as a traitor. Killed at the age of 67, her execution is remembered as one of the most shocking of Tudor times.

programme.title: Father Brown
programme.desc: When Gillian Fletcham reveals a talent scout is heading to Kembleford to find dancers for TV sensation Go Dancing, Mrs Devine and Brenda are delighted. As the showcase nears, Father Brown is shocked at how cut throat the world of competitive dancing is. Gillian dumps her regular dance partner, her brother Derek Fletcham in favour of Italian Stallion Mario Cantoloni, while award-winning couple Pauline Danbury and Robert Danbury find the pressure a strain on their relationship. The very next day, Gillian is found murdered at the dance school. Derek is firmly in the frame, but Father Brown isn't convinced and investigates the dancing rivalries. Fifties-set crime drama, guest starring Kevin Clifton, with Mark Williams

programme.title: Death in Paradise
programme.desc: The island is rocked when Saint Marie's governor Caroline Bamber drops dead at her leaving party, with the commissioner standing right next to her. As DI Goodman and the team try to deduce how she could have been poisoned without their boss noticing any foul play, they find themselves entering the murky world of island politics, where blackmail, threats and corruption seem commonplace - fuelled by ongoing tension between the French and British. Meanwhile, Humphrey braves the world of online dating, under the guidance of ladies' man Dwayne - and soon finds his perfect match. Lucy Cohu and Nigel Lindsay guest star

programme.title: Death in Paradise
programme.desc: A fashion show takes a chilling turn when young model Zoe Mackay is strangled just moments after leaving the catwalk, and while the crew and other models come under suspicion, they all have watertight alibis. To make matters worse, there are no witnesses or DNA evidence, the only clue being a single stocking clasped in the victim's hand. What does it mean - and how was her killer able to strike without being spotted? Meanwhile, Florence tries to help Humphrey improve his social skills with the opposite sex, and JP recognises one of the models as a school crush on at school. But will she remember him?

programme.title: Seven Worlds, One Planet
programme.desc: David Attenborough looks at the wildlife of Europe, a crowded continent hiding the most surprising animals in pockets of wilderness. Gibraltar Nature Reserve is home to Europe's only wild population of primates, with its Barbary macaques living a life of kidnapping and high drama, while in the cemeteries of Vienna graverobbing European hamsters do battle with one another. Italian mountain villages are the hunting grounds for rarely seen wolves, and lynx lurk in the forests of Spain

programme.title: Seven Worlds, One Planet
programme.desc: David Attenborough looks at life in North America, which is defined by extreme weather and seasonal change - from tornados that roar across the prairies, to arctic air sweeping through the humid, southern swamps. In winter, lynx prowl the snowy Yukon for snowshoe hares, while Florida manatees seek hot springs to escape the freeze, while in summer fireflies light up the forests at night. Plus, footage of roadrunners cruising the spectacular deserts of Arizona, and polar bears leaping from rocks to hunt beluga whales

programme.title: Seven Worlds, One Planet
programme.desc: David Attenborough looks at the fauna of Africa, home to the greatest wildlife gatherings on Earth. But even in this land of plenty, animals face huge challenges. At its heart is a vast tropical rainforest full of life, where young chimpanzees learn how to use tools to make the most of the jungles riches. With knowledge passed down from generation to generation, they can access the best forest foods

programme.title: Great Continental Railway Journeys

programme.title: The Repair Shop
programme.desc:
Jay Blades and the team bring three treasured family heirlooms, and the memories they hold, back to life.
First up are sisters Daisy and Indiana Perry with their father's damaged motor bike saddle bags. They are here to entrust them with leather restoration expert Susie Fletcher. Their father, Mark, is a devoted biker and the bags have accompanied him on the open road for tens of thousands of miles. Unfortunately, Mark was involved in an accident on his bike ten years ago and suffered a brain injury, which means days out on his bike are limited. Daisy and Indiana know how much it would mean to him to have these trusty bags repaired and back on his bike for his precious final rides, and fellow motorbike fan Suzie is only too happy to help.
Mechanical marvel Steve Fletcher welcomes Ben Chaffe to the workshop with his late grandfather's barometer. Ben spent holidays as a child at his grandparents' house on the Dorset coast, and every morning the barometer was consulted before each day's activities were planned. Its predictions were taken very seriously, and young Ben was very impressed with its accuracy. The barometer was left to him when his dear grandfather died, for which he felt honoured. It hung in his kitchen, until one fateful day, when the nail that supported it gave way and it smashed on the floor tiles. Steve needs patience, know-how and a bit of good fortune to get this gadget going.
Lastly, stained-glass craftsman Matt Nickels and blacksmith Dom Chinea join forces to work on a decorative window panel with a remarkable story. Johnathan Shonfeld is the proud owner of the one-hundred-year-old stained glass panel, which sat above his grandparents' front door in North London. His family were heroes during the holocaust, rescuing hundreds of Jewish children from across Europe and Johnathan is keen to preserve this piece of important history.
