programme.title: Terms of Endearment
programme.desc: Oscar-winning melodrama starring Shirley MacLaine, Debra Winger and Jack Nicholson. Aurora Greenway is an attractive widow whose main problems in life are fending off an alarming number of suitors and keeping her headstrong daughter Emma in check. But as the years pass by, Aurora's attitude to life and love, and her relationship with her daughter, begin to change.

programme.title: Jerry Maguire
programme.desc: Romantic comedy starring Tom Cruise, Cuba Gooding Jr and Renee Zellweger. As a top agent at Sports Management International, Jerry Maguire knows his way around and is his own man... until one day he gets an attack of decency and finds himself out of a job. Now he must start from scratch. His only allies are a single mother, her cheeky young son and a second-rate player for the Arizona Cardinals.

programme.title: Grease
programme.desc: Musical based on the hit stage show, starring John Travolta and Olivia Newton-John. Unexpectedly reunited with summer love Danny at her new high school, Sandy Olsson can't believe how different he is. Can the new Danny Zuko, the leather-clad, tough-talking leader of the T-birds, really be the boy she met down at the beach? Perhaps Frenchy and Rizzo, both members of the super-cool Pink Ladies gang, can help her develop some street cred to win back his heart.

programme.title: Grease 2
programme.desc: Musical starring Michelle Pfeiffer and Maxwell Caulfield. September 1961, and it's back to school for the students of Rydell High. As the T-Birds and Pink Ladies reassemble, Michael, a handsome young Englishman, joins the senior class. The status quo is soon under threat when he falls in love with Stephanie, the most beautiful of the Pink Ladies.

programme.title: Stand By Me
programme.desc: Coming-of-age drama, based on a story by Stephen King, starring Wil Wheaton and River Phoenix. A writer looks back on his childhood in late-1950s Oregon, in particular the time when he and his friends set out to find the corpse of a boy believed to have been hit by a train.

programme.title: Snatch
programme.desc: Comedy crime drama starring Brad Pitt, Jason Statham and Benicio Del Toro. In Antwerp, jewel thief Franky Four Fingers steals a huge diamond, but before he can deliver it to his New York boss he is ambushed in London by a Russian mobster's henchmen. Elsewhere in the capital, crimelord Brick Top demands that Irish boxer Mickey One Punch take a dive in an unlicensed fight. When Brick Top joins the hunt for the missing gem, mayhem ensues.

programme.title: Murder by Numbers
programme.desc: Detective thriller starring Sandra Bullock and Ben Chaplin. An overprivileged teenager and his bookish companion think they have committed the perfect murder, but emotionally damaged cop Cassie Mayweather has a hunch that they are the culprits. Her problem is convincing sceptical colleagues that she's right.

programme.title: No Ordinary Heist
programme.desc: Two feuding bank employees are forced to execute Ireland's biggest heist after criminals kidnap their families and threaten to kill them. Fact-based thriller, starring Eddie Marsan and Michelle Fairley

programme.title: All the Devils Are Here
programme.desc: Secluded in the middle of Dartmoor, four thieves hide out with nothing to do but count the money and kill time. Thriller, starring Eddie Marsan, Sam Claflin and Burn Gorman

programme.title: Hungry
programme.desc: After becoming lost in the Louisiana swamplands, a group of holiday-makers must fight for their lives against a rampaging hippo on the loose. Horror thriller, starring Madison Davenport and Tracey Bonner

programme.title: The Bourne Legacy
programme.desc: Action thriller starring Jeremy Renner, Rachel Weisz and Edward Norton. As the CIA's covert operations are compromised and details are leaked to the media, intelligence chiefs decide to cut their losses and kill every agent testing their top secret genetic experiment. Agent Aaron Cross manages to escape the onslaught, but must contact the scientist behind Operation Outcome to maintain his enhanced functions and foil his handlers.

programme.title: Snatch
programme.desc: Comedy crime drama starring Brad Pitt, Jason Statham and Benicio Del Toro. In Antwerp, jewel thief Franky Four Fingers steals a huge diamond, but before he can deliver it to his New York boss he is ambushed in London by a Russian mobster's henchmen. Elsewhere in the capital, crimelord Brick Top demands that Irish boxer Mickey One Punch take a dive in an unlicensed fight. When Brick Top joins the hunt for the missing gem, mayhem ensues.

programme.title: Revolver
programme.desc: Crime thriller directed by Guy Ritchie, and starring Jason Statham and Ray Liotta. Jake Green leaves prison determined to avenge the murder of his sister-in-law by men working for ruthless casino boss Dorothy Macha, the person also responsible for his incarceration. But after a confrontation at Macha's club, Green becomes a target for the villain's henchmen.

programme.title: The Hunt for Red October
programme.desc: Cold War action thriller starring Sean Connery, Alec Baldwin and Scott Glenn. The trial voyage of new Soviet submarine Red October does not go as expected. Equipped with an experimental new propulsion system that makes it virtually impossible to track and captained by the enigmatic Marko Ramius, the heavily armed vessel heads for America. Is Ramius about to launch an undetectable, pre-emptive nuclear strike?

programme.title: Jason Bourne
programme.desc: Action thriller starring Matt Damon, Tommy Lee Jones and Alicia Vikander. Now living in self-imposed exile, former agent Jason Bourne is contacted by an old colleague and is soon drawn into an operation to expose CIA dirty tricks. And, as Bourne well knows, nothing is as it seems and no one can be trusted.

programme.title: The Bank Job
programme.desc: Heist thriller based on a true story, starring Jason Statham and Saffron Burrows. In 1970s London, Terry Leather, a car dealer with a dubious past, is approached by his glamorous former girlfriend Martine. She has a plan to steal safe deposit boxes from a top bank, and needs his help to organise the robbery. But the boxes contain more than just valuables, and Terry discovers that several dangerous individuals also want to get hold of them.

programme.title: Basic Instinct
programme.desc: Erotic thriller starring Michael Douglas and Sharon Stone. After a former rock star is brutally murdered with an ice pick, San Francisco detective Nick Curran interviews Catherine Tramell, the star's novelist girlfriend, whose last book contained an identical killing. Curran, who is trying to reform his excessive lifestyle with the help of a police psychologist, soon becomes dangerously involved with his key suspect.

programme.title: A Clockwork Orange
programme.desc: Stanley Kubrick's controversial futuristic vision, dramatised from the novella by Anthony Burgess and starring Malcolm McDowell. Imprisoned after the brutal murder of a woman, Alex, leader of a gang of sadistic thugs, agrees to undergo behaviour therapy designed to turn him against violence. However, when he is released back into the community, the results of the treatment prove to be costly for the reformed Alex.

programme.title: The Mechanic
programme.desc: Remake of the 1972 Charles Bronson action thriller, starring Jason Statham and Ben Foster. Arthur Bishop is a professional hitman who dispatches his victims with the coolness of someone at the top of his game. But when his close friend Harry is murdered, things become personal and Arthur sets out to get revenge with the help of Harry's son.

programme.title: Green Lantern
programme.desc: Fantasy adventure based on the comic book series, starring Ryan Reynolds. Cocky test pilot Hal Jordan is inducted into an intergalactic peacekeeping force when he inherits a ring from an alien race that endows him with superpowers.

Historical action adventure starring Gerard Butler, Lena Headey and David Wenham. When the fiercely ambitious King Xerxes of Persia plans to invade Greece, King Leonidas mobilises his personal bodyguard of 300 Spartan warriors to defend the pass at Thermopylae.

programme.title: Wrath of the Titans
programme.desc: Fantasy action sequel to Clash of the Titans, starring Sam Worthington, Liam Neeson and Ralph Fiennes. A decade after defeating the monstrous Kraken, the demigod Perseus is living a peaceful life with his son, Helius. However, he's called back in to action when his father Zeus is betrayed by Hades and delivered to the Titan Kronos.

programme.title: The Italian Job
programme.desc: Comedy caper starring Michael Caine and Noël Coward. When Charlie Croker is released from prison, he is soon up to no good. After securing the financial backing of crimelord Mr Bridger, he puts into motion plans for a gold-bullion robbery that is to take place in Turin. But the Mafia has other ideas...

programme.title: 300: Rise of an Empire
programme.desc: Ruler of the Persian empire and self-proclaimed god Xerxes continues his campaign to crush the emerging Greek nation, forcing a general from the democratic city state of Athens to lead his navy into battle against Xerxes' vast armada. Fantasy adventure sequel, starring Sullivan Stapleton, Eva Green and Lena Headey

programme.title: The Mummy Returns
programme.desc: Period horror adventure sequel starring Brendan Fraser and Rachel Weisz. When the young son of Rick O'Connell and his Egyptologist wife find an ancient bracelet that holds power over the armies of the fearsome Scorpion King, it attracts the attention of Meela, reincarnated lover of the resurrected high priest Imhotep, who needs the artefact to help him defeat the Scorpion King and become the ultimate ruler.

programme.title: Transformers: Revenge of the Fallen
programme.desc: Sci-fi action sequel starring Shia LaBeouf and Megan Fox. The ancient history of the Transformers' presence on Earth is revealed as the human race battles the first ever Decepticon, and once again Sam Witwicky is in the thick of the action.

programme.title: Olympus Has Fallen
programme.desc: Action thriller starring Gerard Butler, Morgan Freeman and Aaron Eckhart. A disgraced former bodyguard to the President of the United States gets the chance to redeem himself when he becomes trapped inside the White House following a terrorist attack.

programme.title: London Has Fallen
programme.desc: Action thriller starring Gerard Butler, Aaron Eckhart and Morgan Freeman. Three years after the attack on the White House, Mike Banning is back in the Secret Service and travels to London with President Benjamin Asher for the Prime Minister's funeral. The world's leaders are also in attendance but little do they know that a plot to assassinate them and capture Asher is about to come to fruition... with catastrophic results.

programme.title: Venom
programme.desc: Action fantasy starring Tom Hardy, Michelle Williams and Riz Ahmed. While continuing an investigation into the Life Foundation, the mysterious organisation that ruined both his career and his relationship months earlier, struggling reporter Eddie Brock unwittingly becomes the host of a ferociously unpredictable alien parasite. But is the shape-shifting organism a force for good or evil?

programme.title: The Running Man
programme.desc: Desperate to save his sick daughter, Ben Richards enters a deadly televised competition where contestants must survive 30 days while being hunted by professional assassins. Director Edgar Wright's comedy thriller based on the Stephen King story, starring Glen Powell, Lee Pace and Josh Brolin

programme.title: Jurassic Park III
programme.desc: Science-fiction adventure starring Sam Neill and William H Macy. Dr Alan Grant is persuaded by a seemingly wealthy couple to accompany them on a sight-seeing flight over the dinosaur-inhabited Isla Sorna. But he soon discovers that he has been used as a pawn in a game that will once again bring him face to face with the giant reptiles.

programme.title: The Karate Kid Part III
programme.desc: The teenage martial arts expert becomes obsessed with defending his championship title, but wise mentor Mr Miyagi is not prepared to help him fight for such a shallow goal. Seeking someone else to help guide his career, he falls under the influence of a crooked trainer - who is secretly plotting his downfall with the help of an old adversary. Adventure sequel, starring Ralph Macchio and Pat Morita

programme.title: The Karate Kid
programme.desc: Martial arts adventure, a remake of the popular 1984 film, starring Jackie Chan and Jaden Smith. Moving from his home town of Detroit to China is quite a culture shock for young Dre Parker, a situation made worse when he falls foul of the class bully. But under the guidance of maintenance man Mr Han, Dre learns to defend himself.

programme.title: Liar Liar
programme.desc: Comedy starring Jim Carrey. Lawyer Fletcher Reede is a compulsive liar. When his deceits lead to him missing his son's birthday party, the boy makes a wish that his dad would find it impossible not to tell the truth. The wish comes magically true - with hilarious consequences.

programme.title: Gabby's Dollhouse: The Movie
programme.desc: When Gabby's prized dollhouse ends up with eccentric cat lady Vera, the youngster embarks on a adventure to reunite the Gabby Cats and retrieve her beloved diorama before it's too late. Comedy adventure, starring Laila Lockhart Kraner and Kristen Wiig

programme.title: The Borrowers
programme.desc: Fantasy adventure starring John Goodman and Jim Broadbent. Pod, Homily and their children Peagreen and Arietty are the Borrowers, a family of tiny people living secretly in the house of young Pete. When Pete's Great Aunt Mary dies, no one can find the will and it looks as if the house may fall into the hands of nasty local lawyer, Ocious P Potter, and put the little family in danger.

programme.title: Lemony Snicket's A Series of Unfortunate Events
programme.desc: Fantasy comedy adventure based on the first three titles in the bestselling children's book series, starring Jim Carrey and Meryl Streep. After their parents die in a mysterious fire, three young siblings are entrusted to the care of their distant relative, the evil Count Olaf. An actor and master of disguise, he's prepared to go to any length to swindle them out of their family fortune.

programme.title: Peter Rabbit
programme.desc: Part-animated fantasy featuring the voice of James Corden, and starring Rose Byrne and Domhnall Gleeson. Peter Rabbit and his family take great pleasure in stealing vegetables from the garden of crotchety old Mr McGregor. But when the old man unexpectedly dies and his nephew inherits his home, Peter and co are confronted with a formidable new foe.

programme.title: Peter Rabbit 2: The Runaway
programme.desc: Part-animated fantasy featuring the voice of James Corden. Peter is now the star of Bea's children's book about his misadventures on Mr McGregor's farm. But when a new publisher comes on the scene, Peter finds himself being painted as a villain, and wonders if he'd be better off on his own.

programme.title: Jumanji
programme.desc: Fantasy adventure starring Robin Williams. In 1969, a young boy called Alan gets trapped in the strange jungle world of a magical board game he has unearthed on a building site. Twenty-six years later, two children discover the game and unwittingly unleash its dangerous magic. They also release Alan, now an adult, who realises that to escape the game they must play it to the end.

programme.title: Cats & Dogs
programme.desc: Part-animated fantasy comedy starring Jeff Goldblum and Elizabeth Perkins. Beagle puppy Lou is inadvertently enlisted to fight in the ongoing war against the feline population. Can he save the day against megalomaniac cat Mr Tinkles?

programme.title: Cats & Dogs: The Revenge of Kitty Galore
programme.desc: Part-animated fantasy featuring the voices of Bette Midler and James Marsden. When one crazed feline goes to extreme lengths to take power, cats and canines are forced to do the unthinkable and join forces for the first time in history.

programme.title: Liar Liar
programme.desc: Comedy starring Jim Carrey. Lawyer Fletcher Reede is a compulsive liar. When his deceits lead to him missing his son's birthday party, the boy makes a wish that his dad would find it impossible not to tell the truth. The wish comes magically true - with hilarious consequences.

programme.title: Jumanji: Welcome to the Jungle
programme.desc: Fantasy adventure starring Dwayne Johnson, Karen Gillan, Kevin Hart and Jack Black. Four high-school students discover a dusty 1990s video game and are sucked into its world as the characters they chose. They soon discover that if they lose their three "lives" in the game, they will be killed in real life. In order to survive, they must complete the game and break its curse.

programme.title: Casper
programme.desc: Supernatural comedy fantasy starring Christina Ricci, Bill Pullman, Cathy Moriarty and Eric Idle. A wicked heiress hires Dr Harvey, a specialist on ghosts, to rid the haunted house she has inherited of its unwanted inhabitants. But Casper, the nice nephew of nasty ghosts Stretch, Stinkie and Fatso, strikes up a friendship with the doctor's daughter.

programme.title: Jack the Giant Slayer
programme.desc: Fantasy adventure starring Nicholas Hoult and Ewan McGregor. Humanity is put on the menu when a farm boy opens the gateway between our world and a fearsome giant race.

programme.title: Grease

Unexpectedly reunited with summer love Danny at her new high school, Sandy Olsson can't believe how different he is. Can the new Danny Zuko, the leather-clad, tough-talking leader of the T-birds, really be the boy she met down at the beach? Perhaps Frenchy and Rizzo, both members of the super-cool Pink Ladies gang, can help her develop some street cred to win back his heart.

Tomboy Vada Sultenfuss is not only a hypochondriac, but also preoccupied with death - a condition not helped by the fact that she lives above a funeral parlour where her father Harry works as a mortician. When Harry employs Shelly to help in the mortuary, Vada is concerned that her father and Shelly will become involved. So, along with her best friend Thomas J, she sets out to spy on the couple.

programme.title: My Girl 2
programme.desc: Drama starring Dan Aykroyd, Jamie Lee Curtis and Anna Chlumsky. A young girl decides to write about her mother, who died in childbirth, for a school project. When she goes to stay in her mother's old house with her uncle Phil, she finds help in her detective work coming from an unexpected quarter.

programme.title: Moneyball
programme.desc: The manager of a struggling baseball team faces disaster, as his star players are bought out by richer clubs and he is unable to afford to replace them. An economics student offers him a solution to his problems, finding a ground-breaking way to analyse the performance of cheaper players and combining their abilities to form a winning side. Fact-based drama, starring Brad Pitt, Jonah Hill and Philip Seymour Hoffman

programme.title: Escape to Victory
programme.desc: Second World War drama starring Sylvester Stallone, Michael Caine and Pelé. As a propaganda stunt, the Nazis arrange a football match between the national German team and a squad made up of prisoners of war. However, the PoW team see the game as a chance to attempt an audacious escape.

programme.title: Bohemian Rhapsody
programme.desc: Biographical music drama starring Rami Malek. London, 1970: living with his parents, Farrokh Bulsara dreams of becoming a rock star. So when local group Smile loses its lead singer, he convinces guitarist Brian May and drummer Roger Taylor to give him a shot. With the addition of bassist John Deacon and Bulsara changing his name to Freddie Mercury, the band Queen is born - but the path to world domination is a bumpy one.

programme.title: Quartet
programme.desc: Comedy drama based on Ronald Harwood's play, directed by Dustin Hoffman and starring Maggie Smith, Tom Courtenay and Billy Connolly. At the Beecham House retirement home for opera singers, the occasion of Verdi's birthday is always marked by a special fundraising concert. But this year the arrival of one particular grande dame throws preparations into chaos as egos clash and old resentments surface.

programme.title: The Boy in the Striped Pyjamas
programme.desc: Second World War drama starring Asa Butterfield, Jack Scanlon and David Thewlis. After his Nazi officer father is given a promotion, young Bruno and his family are moved from Berlin to a remote house in the countryside. With nothing to do and no friends of his own age, Bruno becomes curious about a nearby building known as "the farm" and its oddly clothed inhabitants.

programme.title: Rocketman
programme.desc: Biographical musical drama starring Taron Egerton and Jamie Bell. From the safety of an addiction rehab group, a flamboyantly dressed man recalls the highs and lows of his childhood and transformation from talented young pianist Reggie Dwight into global superstar Elton John.

programme.title: A Star Is Born
programme.desc: Musical romantic drama starring Lady Gaga and Bradley Cooper. Rock star Jackson Maine meets aspiring songwriter Ally, a waitress who moonlights as a bar singer. Mesmerised by Ally's talent, Jackson invites her to perform with him and she becomes a sensation. The two begin a romantic relationship, but their happiness is threatened as an increasingly washed-up Jackson grapples with substance abuse issues.

programme.title: Moneyball

An economics student offers him a solution to his problems, finding a ground-breaking way to analyse the performance of cheaper players and combining their abilities to form a winning side. Fact-based drama, starring Brad Pitt, Jonah Hill and Philip Seymour Hoffman

programme.title: The Pursuit of Happyness
programme.desc: Drama based on a true story, starring Will Smith and featuring Jaden Smith. After his wife walks out, downtrodden medical salesman Chris Gardner is left to bring up his five-year-old son alone. The situation worsens when the pair are made homeless, but Gardner refuses to be beaten. Gaining a prestigious though unpaid stockbroker internship, he doggedly chases his dream of a better life.

programme.title: Escape to Victory
programme.desc: Second World War drama starring Sylvester Stallone, Michael Caine and Pelé. As a propaganda stunt, the Nazis arrange a football match between the national German team and a squad made up of prisoners of war. However, the PoW team see the game as a chance to attempt an audacious escape.

programme.title: Zoolander 2
programme.desc: Comedy sequel starring Ben Stiller, Owen Wilson and Penélope Cruz. Once-legendary catwalk icon Derek Zoolander is lured back into the fashion business by a beautiful agent investigating a spate of celebrity deaths.

programme.title: Spinal Tap II: The End Continues
programme.desc: Nigel Tufnel, David St Hubbins and Derek Smalls reunite after a 15-year break for one final concert. Their progress is charted once more by documentary maker Marti DiBergi, who offers perhaps too much perspective on their new direction. Comedy sequel, written by and starring Michael McKean, Harry Shearer, Christopher Guest and director Rob Reiner, in his final film. Kerry Godliman and Chris Addison also star with cameos by Paul McCartney, Elton John and Garth Brooks

programme.title: Twinless
programme.desc: A young man left broken by the loss of his twin brother joins a support group for 'twinless twins.' Dark comedy, starring Dylan O'Brien and Lauren Graham

programme.title: Roofman
programme.desc: Former US Army Reserve officer Jeffrey Manchester executes a plan to rob multiple branches of McDonald's. He is eventually captured by police and becomes the first person to escape from Brown Creek Correctional Institution in North Carolina. Jeffrey hides out at a toy shop for several months, and during forays outside the building, he sparks romance with store worker Leigh Wainscott. Comedy drama, starring Channing Tatum, Kirsten Dunst and Peter Dinklage

programme.title: About Last Night
programme.desc: Danny has always played second fiddle to his wise-cracking pal, Bernie. So after his mate starts dating Joan, Danny falls for her friend, Debbie, and following a one-night stand, Danny and Debbie pursue a relationship, despite the warnings of their cynical friends. Remake of the 1986 romantic comedy, starring Kevin Hart, Michael Ealy, Regina Hall and Joy Bryant

programme.title: Beverly Hills Cop III
programme.desc: Action comedy starring Eddie Murphy and Judge Reinhold. When his boss is murdered, Detroit cop Axel Foley tracks down the suspects to a California theme park called Wonder World. With old friend Billy Rosewood, Foley sets out to crack the case.

programme.title: Panda Plan
programme.desc: An international action superstar gets involved in a rescue operation of a beloved zoo panda named Hu Hu. Chinese comedy, starring Jackie Chan and Xiang Wei, with subtitles

programme.title: Panda Plan 2: The Magical Tribe
programme.desc: Giant Panda Hu Hu and an adventurer accidentally stumble into a mysterious primitive tribe, beginning an unprecedented adventure. Action comedy, with Jackie Chan and Li Ma

programme.title: Mother's Pride
programme.desc: A grieving family who own a failing pub have their lives changed by brewing real ale and entering the Great British Beer Awards. Comedy, starring Martin Clunes, James Buckley and Miles Jupp

programme.title: Bride Wars
programme.desc: Comedy with Anne Hathaway and Kate Hudson. Best friends Emma and Liv have vowed to marry one day in New York's Plaza Hotel - but when the time comes to plan their respective weddings, a clerical error means they are both booked at the venue on the same day. With neither willing to budge, the pair engage in attempts to sabotage each other's big day.

programme.title: Mr Deeds
programme.desc: Remake of Frank Capra's comedy Mr Deeds Goes to Town, starring Adam Sandler and Winona Ryder. Longfellow Deeds lives an uncomplicated life as a pizza-shop owner and aspiring greetings-card writer in a tiny town. But his world is thrown into disarray when he inherits a fortune from an unknown uncle.

programme.title: Nirvanna the Band the Show the Movie
programme.desc: When a scheme to book a show at a local nightspot goes disastrously wrong, Toronto musicians Matt and Jay are unexpectedly transported back to 2008. Fantasy comedy, starring Matt Johnson and Jay McCarrol

programme.title: We're the Millers
programme.desc: Comedy starring Jennifer Aniston and Jason Sudeikis. In order to repay a debt to his drug supplier, small-time pot dealer David Clark agrees to smuggle a shipment of marijuana across the Mexican border. However, to carry out the deception, David recruits a stripper and two teenagers to pose as his family.

programme.title: Roofman
programme.desc: Former US Army Reserve officer Jeffrey Manchester executes a plan to rob multiple branches of McDonald's. He is eventually captured by police and becomes the first person to escape from Brown Creek Correctional Institution in North Carolina. Jeffrey hides out at a toy shop for several months, and during forays outside the building, he sparks romance with store worker Leigh Wainscott. Comedy drama, starring Channing Tatum, Kirsten Dunst and Peter Dinklage

programme.title: The Outsider
programme.desc: A British military contractor leaves Afghanistan for Los Angeles when he receives word that his daughter has died there. However, he discovers the body identified as her is someone else, and embarks on a rampage of violence through the criminal underworld to discover what has really happened to her. Action thriller, starring Craig Fairbrass, Jason Patric and James Caan

programme.title: The Internecine Project
programme.desc: Thriller starring James Coburn and Lee Grant. Tipped to take a major post in the American government, Robert Elliot is faced with one big problem: a quartet of people know of his dangerous and illegal activities in England. Elliot devises an ingenious plan whereby all four will kill each other.

programme.title: Crack in the World
programme.desc: Science-fiction thriller starring Dana Andrews, Janette Scott and Kieron Moore. A scientist instigates Project Inner Space - a scheme to harness the Earth's energy by drilling through to its core. But a crisis looms as a huge crack appears, threatening the destruction of the planet.

programme.title: The Lost World
programme.desc: Roxton, Malone, and Marguerite save a man, named Tom, who's staked between two trees. He claims to be Veronica's long lost father, escaped from slavery and on the run from a bounty hunter. But when the group takes Tom back to the treehouse to reunite with with Veronica, he reveals more sinister motives.

programme.title: Teleshopping
programme.desc: Buying goods from the comfort of home

programme.title: Miami Magma
programme.desc: A volcanologist discovers an illegal oil-drilling operation has tapped into a dormant volcano and tries to get the rig shut down before it causes a devastating eruption - but the company responsible is determined to cover up the danger. Disaster thriller, starring Rachel Hunter, Brad Dourif and Melissa Ordway

programme.title: This is Legend Xtra

programme.title: SpeakGaelic
programme.desc:
Joy Dunlop gar toirt tro na h-ath cheumannan gus Gàidhlig a bhruidhinn. Tha Liam Alastair Crouse às Na Stàitean Aonaichte a' tadhal air Joy san stiùidio agus tha Calum MacIlleathain a' gabhail turas bàta gus lorg fhaighinn air eòin-mhara gu math sònraichte.
Lorgar tuilleadh stuthan taic air-loidhne aig www.speakgaelic.scot agus ann an sreath phodcastan air BBC Sounds.
Joy Dunlop guides us through the next steps to speak Gaelic. Liam Alastair Crouse from the United States chats to Joy in the studio and Calum Maclean takes a boat trip to a colony of characterful seabirds.
Supporting materials can be found online at www.speakgaelic.scot and in the SpeakGaelic podcasts on BBC Sounds.

programme.title: An Là (News)
programme.desc: Local, national and international news and information from BBC Alba

programme.title: Mod 2026
programme.desc: Linda MacLeod and Hannah McKirdy are in Glasgow’s Royal Concert Hall to present some of the winners from the second day of coverage of the children’s Mòd in Glasgow. The spotlight falls on young fluent Gaelic speakers and the programme features winners who will take home a range of gold badges, cups and trophies for various competitions - including solo singing, choral singing and poetry recitation. The programme also features the winners of the premier prizes for traditional singing

programme.title: Miann na Maighdinn-mara (Mermaid Tales)
programme.desc: Kate Macleod makes her way to Berneray and meets with locals such as Donald MacLean, who explains what life was like there in days gone by. He shares with her the story of the Giant Angus MacAskill, who made a living from his height - all seven foot, nine inches of him. Roddy Shaw shares his story of growing up on Berneray and attending high school in Harris, as well as some interesting folklore about the landscape of the island. Kate attempts to swim with seals and also kayaks around the shores of the stunning West Beach - which was recently named the most beautiful beach in Europe

programme.title: Machair
programme.desc: Gaelic soap based on the Isle of Lewis

programme.title: Aig an Taigh le Abigail
programme.desc:
Bàlaichean Banana, còrdaidh 'ad ris a' mhòr-chuid. Tha Abigail gan dèanamh às ùr, 's gan taisbeanadh gu brèagha. Greim-bìdh glè bhlasta.
Banana Balls, most people will love them. Abigail makes them from scratch and presents them beautifully. A very tasty snack.
In Gaelic with English subtitles.

programme.title: Alleluia! (Spiritual Music & Verse)

programme.title: Countryfile
programme.desc: Matt Baker and Emily McGowen are in the Cotswolds for the biggest date in the sheepdog trialling calendar - the Supreme. The finest dogs and handlers from across the UK and Ireland take part in a showcase of instinct, skill and control. After months of training and a year of tough qualifying trials, only one will claim the title of Supreme Champion

programme.title: The Celebrity Traitors
programme.desc: As the first banishment unfolds, the faithful are hoping that they've caught a traitor, while the traitors themselves are desperate to keep their identities concealed. The celebrities must put their trust in one another during a mission that fuels suspicion and paranoia amongst the players

programme.title: The Celebrity Traitors: Uncloaked
programme.desc: Ed Gamble hears from the latest banished and murdered players from episode 3 about their time in the castle, and he gets their reactions to the Traitors' identities

programme.title: Bargain Hunt
programme.desc: Two PhD students and a father and daughter search the antiques stalls of Southwell Racecourse in Nottinghamshire with experts Lesley Kiddell-Spencer and Irita Marriot. Presenter Eric Knowles challenges fairgoers to identify a mystery object made of a hard wood that has a screw top with holes pierced in it

programme.title: Escape to the Country
programme.desc: City-dwelling families, couples and individuals set out to find their ideal rural retreats with the help of a property expert

programme.title: The Best of Weatherman Walking
programme.desc: Derek Brockway recalls three of his favourite coastal walks, including jet-skiing off Abersoch beach and the time he got a dunking in Pembrokeshire. He also remembers the time he discovered why Porth Neigwl is dubbed Hell's Mouth and when he met volunteers called the Silver Slashers

programme.title: The Best of Weatherman Walking
programme.desc: Derek Brockway follows the river Taff to Brecon, stands on Devil's Bridge in Pontarfynach and takes the train around Barmouth Bay as he revisits his favourite waterways walks

programme.title: BBC News
programme.desc: A round-up of the latest headlines

programme.title: Politics Live
programme.desc: The latest stories from Westminster and beyond

programme.title: Impossible
programme.desc:
Game show presented by Rick Edwards in which players score points by answering questions correctly. However, they must avoid the Impossible answers, otherwise they will be eliminated from the show until the next day.
In each episode, there are three rounds, and the three highest scorers from each round play against each other in the final. The winner of this battle faces a £10,000 question.

programme.title: Welsh First Minister's Questions
programme.desc: The First Minister answers questions from MSs from the Senedd in Cardiff Bay

programme.title: The Answer Run
programme.desc: Jason Manford hosts the fast-paced quiz show where three couples face a series of 50/50 questions which hurtle down the Answer Run towards them. Across three rounds, the couples build up their cash pots, but only one pair can face the Final Run and earn the opportunity to take home their cash prize

programme.title: The Boss
programme.desc: Quiz hosted by Susan Calman in which one contestant becomes the Boss and has to use judgement and tactics to decide which player is best suited to answer questions

programme.title: The Wonder of Animals
programme.desc: Chris Packham explores the anatomy and physiology of the largest land animal on the planet, the elephant. Its size seems ill-suited to surviving the most arid regions of Africa, but its inner workings allow it to defy the extreme heat of the desert, and find food and water in seemingly barren landscapes, while its extraordinary memory enables it to repel predators. Here, Chris reveals how hairs on the skin help to keep the elephant cool, and how sensors in its feet may be able to guide it toward rain

programme.title: Landward
programme.desc: Dougie Vipond is in Easter Ross on the shores of the Cromarty Firth to meet a couple with a seed-growing business in the area's fertile farmland. Cammy Wilson is in Angus to hearing how award-winning beef famers made the switch back to native cattle for better results, while Rachel Bell continues her journey round the Buchan coast and has a lesson in making fishing nets, and Arlene Stuart heads to Jura to find out how three women are making a living and living their dream.

programme.title: Flog It!
programme.desc: Charlie Ross and Christina Trevanion evaluate antiques at the Fleet Air Arm Museum, situated on the Navy's largest aviation base, HMS Heron in Yeovilton, Somerset. Paul Martin travels to London to find out more about renowned scientist Thomas Young

programme.title: House of Games
programme.desc: Chizzy Akudolu, Stephen Bailey, Banjo Beale and Philippa Dunne test their general knowledge skills in a variety of trivia-based games

programme.title: Strictly: It Takes Two
programme.desc: Ellie Taylor dishes up all the behind-the-scenes action from the ballroom with a panel of Strictly celebrities. Also, Anton Du Beke will swing by for a chat

programme.title: The One Show
programme.desc: Alex Jones and Roman Kemp present another mix of nationwide reports and live studio-based chat

programme.title: EastEnders
programme.desc: Jean attempts to lift Kat's spirits with flowers that remind her of Zoe - but she continues to struggle with her grief. Mark faces an impossible choice and Amy's lies begin to unravel when Craig discovers evidence that others have been in his flat

programme.title: DIY SOS
programme.desc: Nick Knowles meets a family in Preston, Lancashire who need the team's help to rebuild their house so their son Daniel, who had complex disabilities after brain tumour surgery, can finally come home from hospital. But as the regulars embark on an epic, near-impossible build, aided by an army of local builders and other volunteers, they find themselves pushed to breaking point

programme.title: Blue Lights
programme.desc: As Gerry's murder trial begins, Mo's unstable mental health ignites a struggle between the state and justice. Shane has a tense stand-off with Lee

programme.title: QI
programme.desc: Sandi Toksvig looks at tubes and tubas in a totally tubular show, with panellists Alan Davies, Sara Pascoe, Bridget Christie and Deborah Frances-White

programme.title: Newsnight
programme.desc: Analysis of the day's events, with Victoria Derbyshire

programme.title: John Simpson - Sixty Years at the BBC
programme.desc: John Simpson takes a look back at his 60-year career at the BBC - reporting on the biggest global news stories of the era. He reflects on the changing world he has witnessed, including the revolution in Iran that seemed destined to fail, his brutal kidnapping in Beirut, and the fall of the Berlin Wall. John also reminisces on memorable encounters with inspiring leaders and cruel dictators

programme.title: Damilola: The Untold Story
programme.desc: Twenty-six years after the murder of 10-year-old Damilola Taylor shocked Britain, this documentary examines his story with new testimony that sheds fresh light on what happened. programme.title: Building Off the Grid

programme.title: Building Off the Grid
programme.desc: A Texas couple teams up with two South African canvas tent experts to create their dream glamping experience. But they soon find the build is anything but luxurious. With rain, heat, and critters, they have to work together to reach the finish line.

programme.title: Expedition Unknown

programme.desc: In a rescue first, the Raneys arrive at a Washington State homestead and find the couple's cabin recently collapsed. With winter weeks away, on land with a dangerous "predator funnel," the race is on to solve the shelter, food and predator threats.

programme.title: Outback Opal Hunters
programme.desc: The Fire Crew's season rests on a knife-edge as they battle their way back from a disastrous setback. Plus, the Opal Queen mines rock hard walls alone.

programme.title: Outback Opal Hunters
programme.desc: Rookie Justin tackles a deal that could make or break him. The Boulder Boys race to save their claim from a monsoon flood, while the Cooke Brothers finally make a valuable discovery

programme.title: Aussie Gold Hunters
programme.desc: Jacqui and Andrew blaze a new trail into a remote corner of Fish Creek, but a washout threatens to stop their bulldozer in its tracks. The Gold Devils roll the dice on a costly move to new ground. And, McGhie's hunch on a new dig site pulls in big gold.

programme.title: Aussie Gold Hunters
programme.desc: In Western Australia, the Heli Hunters are forced to make an emergency landing in remote country. The Brumbies can't seem to catch a break. While in Victoria, Nev leads the Poseidon Crew to a secret patch in big nugget country.

programme.title: Outback Truckers

programme.title: Aussie Gold Hunters
programme.desc: Alan and Salty fight impenetrable bush to pursue a gold rush legend in the hidden valleys of the Margaret River. plus, the McGhies try to work two patches at once despite failing machinery.

programme.title: Expedition X

programme.title: Let's Be Cops

programme.title: Bao
programme.desc: An ageing woman suffering from empty nest syndrome gets another chance at motherhood when she makes a dumpling that magically springs to life. Oscar-nominated Pixar short, featuring the voice of Sindy Lau

programme.title: Bambi

programme.title: The Good Dinosaur
programme.desc: Pixar comedy adventure featuring the voices of Raymond Ochoa and Jack Bright. On an alternative Earth where dinosaurs did not become extinct 65 million years ago, a young apatosaurus called Arlo is separated from his family and becomes lost in a dangerous world of predators. He forms an unlikely friendship with a cave-boy, but Arlo soon realises he will have to confront his worst fears to reunite with his loved ones.

programme.title: The Little Mermaid
programme.desc: Animated musical adventure based on a story by Hans Christian Andersen, featuring the voices of Jodi Benson and René Auberjonois. Plucky mermaid Ariel, daughter of King Triton, is unhappy with her life beneath the waves and makes a deal with devious sea witch Ursula to help her go on land and meet her prince.

programme.title: Treasure Planet

When a pirate treasure map falls into the hands of young tearaway Jim Hawkins, he is determined to find the fabled loot. Joining a space galleon as a cabin boy, he sets off on an intergalactic voyage of discovery, under the watchful eye of mysterious cyborg cook John Silver.

programme.title: Wish
programme.desc: Seventeen-year-old Asha makes a wish on a star to save her kingdom from rising evil and her plea is answered by a celestial body with the power to grant further desires. Animated fantasy featuring the voice of Arianna DeBose

But when he breaks into the house of scientist Hank Pym and cracks the safe, all that's within is a strange-looking bodysuit. Little does Lang know that Pym has been observing him and the suit has incredible size-changing powers.

programme.title: Juno

Discovering that she's pregnant after having sex for the first time, 16-year-old Juno MacGuff weighs up her options. With abortion out of the question, she decides to have the baby adopted, but first she must face her parents.

programme.title: Conan the Barbarian

programme.title: Modern Family

programme.desc: While Claire and Haley fall ill at the same time, Phil wages battle against a defective smoke detector after concluding it is saying 'you're not a man' to him. Elsewhere, Manny accidentally gets one of Jay's employees dismissed. Comedy, starring Ty Burrell and Julie Bowen

programme.title: The Simpsons
programme.desc: Marge writes a novel and succeeds in getting it published to critical acclaim in the Springfield community. Homer is delighted - until he finds out its plot, which portrays him as an uncaring husband. With the guest voices of authors Tom Clancy and Thomas Pynchon

programme.title: The Simpsons
programme.desc: At the Springfield library, Marge stimulates the children's interest in history by relating extraordinary tales featuring the wives of Henry VIII, the Lewis and Clark expedition and the early life of Austrian composer Mozart

programme.title: The Simpsons
programme.desc: Milhouse moves to Capital City with his mother, forcing Bart to look for new friends - but he finds himself bonding more strongly with Lisa. Meanwhile, Homer resorts to begging to raise money for Marge's anniversary gift

programme.title: The Simpsons
programme.desc: Simon Cowell provides the voice of the sharp-tongued administrator of a nursery for gifted children who has the job of deciding whether to accept Maggie. programme.title: The Goldbergs
programme.desc: Barry seeks fresh inspiration when he loses his standing as a champion athlete at school and attempts to introduce a new sport to his friends. programme.title: The Goldbergs
programme.desc: As they bond over their shared love for the movie Dirty Dancing, Beverly is thrilled when Erica suggests the film as the theme for the upcoming school dance. However, Principal Ball refuses to sanction anything with the word 'dirty' in the title, threatening Erica with suspension if she persists with the idea. Barry lobbies for the dance to be based on his favourite movie Footloose, while Adam and Pops encourage Murray to learn to dance in order to make Beverly happy

programme.title: Modern Family
programme.desc: Mitch and Cam try to get Lily on their side when they decide to adopt a baby boy, but have doubts about whether they are adequately prepared to raise another child. Meanwhile, Gloria deals with Manny's head teacher

programme.title: Modern Family
programme.desc: Cam and Mitch go on diets, and Phil is inspired to try his hand at tightrope walking. Meanwhile, Claire tries to plant ideas in the heads of her warring daughters, and Jay's behaviour grates on Gloria

programme.title: Modern Family
programme.desc: Jay helps Manny with a school fundraiser involving lots of wrapping paper, and Claire petitions for a stop sign at a busy junction. Meanwhile, Mitchell is determined to prove a point to Cameron, but neither of them will back down. American comedy, guest starring David Cross (Arrested Development), with Ed O'Neill and Julie Bowen

programme.title: Modern Family
programme.desc: All the men in the three dysfunctional households feel angry - including Mitch and Cam, who are involved in a traffic accident, and Jay, who is frustrated at work. American comedy, starring Ed O'Neill and Julie Bowen

programme.title: The Simpsons
programme.desc: In a parody of Richard Linklater's film Boyhood, this episode is a coming-of-age story chronicling Bart's life from the age of six to him becoming a fully accomplished young man. His tense relationship with Homer is catalogued, as is the fact that he is overshadowed by the more successful Lisa at every turn. These factors shape his personality and his future more than he realises

programme.title: The Simpsons
programme.desc: Marge posts a humorous photo online of Homer eating an ice-cream outside the nuclear plant, prompting Mr Burns to fire him, while a female coder decides to make Lisa her protegee. With the guest voices of Stephen Merchant and Kaitlin Olson

programme.title: The Simpsons
programme.desc: Homer decides to buy a healthier brand of milk, but Apu persuades him to buy a cheaper sort made by Buzz Cola that is full of hormones, while Bart realises he has a crush on his new teacher Mrs Berrera. With the guest voice of Sofía Vergara (Modern Family)

programme.title: The Simpsons
programme.desc: Sanjay's son turns the Kwik-E-Mart into a health-food store against Apu's insistence on tradition. Bart renounces his devotion to pranks after his mischief has unforeseen consequences, but is called upon to return to his wicked ways and take down the new enterprise

programme.title: Hollyoaks
programme.desc: Arguments erupt in the Hutchinson household. Gemma turns to her dad Donny for help. And Leah flees the hospital in search of answers

programme.title: Brooklyn Nine-Nine
programme.desc: Doug Judy (Craig Robinson) is returned to custody after scamming Jake and Rosa in a previous encounter, but Captain Holt offers him a plea deal when he reveals he knows the location of a notorious drug dealer. Meanwhile, Gina and Boyle become concerned about their parents' relationship, and Santiago makes Holt a Christmas gift. Comedy, starring Andy Samberg

programme.title: First Dates
programme.desc: Michael, a 23-year-old neuroscientist and self-confessed geek, goes on a date with publishing assistant Hannah, who is hoping her dream man exists outside of her romantic novels. programme.title: Gogglebox
programme.desc: The armchair critics share their opinions on Hunted, Bake Off: The Professionals, Made in Chelsea, Love in the Jungle, Top of the Pops 1992, Dickinson's Real Deal, Britain's Got Talent, and BBC News coverage of the Prime Minister's apparent involvement in Partygate

programme.title: Gogglebox
programme.desc: The armchair critics share their opinions on programmes including Starstruck, The Home Edit, Made in Chelsea, Celebrity Help My House Is Haunted, SAS, This Is Going to Hurt, Dynasties II and Pam & Tommy. First shown in June 2022

programme.title: Naked Attraction

programme.title: Undercover Boss USA
programme.desc: Cindy Galardi Culpepper, CEO and Chairperson of Wienerschnitzel, the world's largest hot dog chain, goes undercover in disguise to work among her own employees and find out about the quality of communication within the organisation. programme.title: Undercover Boss USA
programme.desc: Lowell Hawthorne, President and CEO of Caribbean food producers Golden Krust, dons a disguise to go undercover among the workforce in his own company. programme.title: Couples Come Dine with Me
programme.desc: In Birmingham, English teacher Corinne and her partner Dal are the first to host in a series of dinner parties, but their evening takes a strange turn when some of the guests prove to be very outspoken. Builder Jack and girlfriend Georgie manage to get their fellow contestants back on side with their food and hosting, and by the time IT workers James and Adele host, expectations are high

programme.title: Couples Come Dine with Me
programme.desc: In Kent, Katie is first up with a menu suited to her husband Dan's huge appetite, but their massive portion sizes prove a challenge to some. Day two sees the turn of wedding DJ Simon and his wife Jacqui, who flummox their guests with a French-language menu, before city broker Paul and his beauty therapist wife Claire hope a dance-off and a ginger dessert will be enough to beat the other two couples to the £1,000

programme.title: Don't Tell the Bride
programme.desc: Sonny is a party fanatic. What will his bride Jazmin think of his plans for a zoo-themed Ibizan beach party with body paint?

programme.title: Don't Tell the Bride
programme.desc: The sky's the limit for adrenaline junkie Jai as he plans on having a wedding on a platform suspended in mid-air, neglecting the fact that his bride-to-be Leanne is terrified of heights

programme.title: Storage Wars
programme.desc: Jarrod and Brandi's plans go awry as the buyers hit Santa Ana and Dave shows up looking to cause trouble

programme.title: Storage Wars
programme.desc: Rene brings his father Gunter to help hunt for collectibles and Ivy takes a gamble for something out of the ordinary

programme.title: Celebrity Undercover Boss USA
programme.desc: Recording artist Darius Rucker goes undercover to find America's next great musical act. Darius first gained fame as lead vocalist and rhythm guitarist of rock band Hootie & the Blowfish, selling over 16 million records and winning two Grammys. He then went on to have a successful solo career as a county music artist. Now Darius wants to find talented but undiscovered new music acts and help launch their careers, so dons a disguise to work at an open mic night, as a roadie and a busker in his efforts to locate fresh songwriting and performing talent

programme.title: Celebrity Undercover Boss USA
programme.desc: Chef and restaurateur Marcus Samuelsson goes undercover to find and mentor America's next great chef. An Ethiopian refugee adopted by a Swedish family, Marcus developed a deep love for cooking at an early age and has since become a renowned force in international cuisine, with over 30 restaurants worldwide. Marcus disguises himself to work incognito in a teaching kitchen, a food truck business, a culinary institute and a soup kitchen, as he searches for undiscovered chefs to mentor

programme.title: America's Funniest Home Videos

programme.title: Storage Wars

programme.title: Storage Wars
programme.desc: Dave augments his inventory with a surprise medical device; Rene finds his furniture locker enlightening; Ivy finds unexpected green.

programme.title: Below Deck
programme.desc: With chef Lawrence still struggling to get to grips with life aboard the St David, Captain Kerry considers making a new appointment. Bosun Caio's leadership skills leave a lot to be desired

programme.title: Geordie Shore
programme.desc: Big boss Anna is fuming when the squad finally return from Ibiza. Marnie's plan to get Aaron's attention backfires and the couple reach crisis point when Nathan gets involved.

programme.title: 24 Hours in A&E
programme.desc: Lynn is rushed to St George's after collapsing from a brain aneurysm. Her friend Mick tells the story of their lifelong friendship and reveals how she overcame serious health problems with the support of him and his wife. James is treated for a dislocated shoulder, and 30-year-old Lucas has a suspected urinary tract infection

programme.title: 999: On the Front Line
programme.desc: Paramedics are called to a man under arrest. He's outside in the street and has hit his head, and the police want to make sure he's well enough to be taken to the station. A mum calls 999 when her six-year-old son has a seizure, and a nurse finds her patient in bed with a fever and having difficulty breathing. The paramedics suspect that he may have fractured a rib

programme.title: Our Farm Next Door: Amanda, Clive and Kids
programme.desc: The Owens battle wind, mist and rain to get a piped water supply to their home. A day out to Beamish Museum provides inspiration for ambitious plans to build a cupboard bed for the children. The floorboards finally arrive on the back of a tractor. Over at Ravenseat, Annas is doing her best to stop the new puppies causing chaos. Sid takes his tractor exam so he can carry out more jobs at the farm, and Tony the Pony gets a much-needed brush down and hoof polish

programme.title: 24 Hours in A&E
programme.desc: A 50-year-old woman is rushed to A&E having collapsed at work following a thunderclap headache, leaving doctors concerned that she may have a bleed on her brain. Her husband shares the story of how they met and the challenges they have had to overcome. Other patients include a 13-year-old boy hit by a car while riding his bike and a woman concerned by a headache, who describes her childhood spent in Zambia and Lancashire

programme.title: A Place in the Sun
programme.desc: Jane and Jilly from Brighton want to buy a holiday home in the picturesque Dordogne region of south west France, on a budget of £100,000

programme.title: Four in a Bed
programme.desc: The competition kicks off in Birkdale on Merseyside, at N'ista Boutique Rooms run by Ian and Sally Lawless. Stylish mother-and-daughter duo Suzie and Dani are impressed by the set-up, and Linda and her friend Lany love the gigantic showers. However, Ian and Sally's chances suffer a setback when married couple Mark and Sean discover strange green goo in the bathroom. After a trip to a local lawnmower museum proves a surprising hit, the hosts go all-out to lay on an impressive breakfast spread

programme.title: Four in a Bed
programme.desc: Mark and Sean welcome their rivals to Oakleigh Guest House in Blackpool, where their USP is value for money. But one pair of guests are upset when their room is a tight squeeze.

programme.title: Four in a Bed
programme.desc: The competition continues as Linda Milner and her friend Lany welcome their guests to Bay House in Scarborough for a socially distanced stay amid the Covid pandemic. One couple are impressed with the grandiose style of their high-ceilinged room, and there's a shock in store when it's revealed that another pair have had to drop out of the competition. Over dinner, everyone discusses how the pandemic has affected them. Confusion reigns at breakfast, denting Linda's scores, and, when she sees her feedback, she finds herself questioning her rivals' motives

programme.title: Four in a Bed
programme.desc: The Farrier in Cayton, North Yorkshire is the week's final destination, run by mother-and-daughter duo Suzie and Dani Bushby. The luxurious rooms go down very well with their guests, before the B&Bers enjoy a day meeting Dani's horses at the family's manor home. During dinner the contestants shed a tear as they reflect fondly on the competition. However, just as Suzie and Dani think they're on the home straight, some issues arise at bedtime for Mark and Sean

programme.title: Four in a Bed
programme.desc: The four sets of owners reunite to settle some scores. Mark and Sean are keen to find out why one pair of guests wouldn't stay at their Oakleigh Guest House again, while Linda and Lany are annoyed about some nitpicking feedback about the flowers in their rooms at Bay House in Scarborough. Later, the payments and winner are revealed

programme.title: Come Dine with Me
programme.desc: New Zealander Steve Levy kicks off a week of dinner parties in Exeter, where he hopes his home-inspired menu consisting of a prawn starter, a fish main course and two desserts will impress his guests - administrator Estelle Macrow, media sales executive Richard Kaye, customer services adviser Sarah Wallis and PR guru Glen King - and make him an early contender for the £1,000 prize

programme.title: Come Dine with Me
programme.desc: Media sales executive and music mad foodie Richard Kaye hosts the second dinner party in Exeter, where he is confident he can impress his guests with his culinary knowledge, and hopes to dazzle one diner in particular

programme.title: Come Dine with Me
programme.desc: Self-assured PR worker Glen King is confident she will be the 'hostess with the mostest' in Exeter, and has gone all-out to impress - even co-ordinating the dishes with her surname. She appears to be unflappable in the kitchen and seems to have a plan for everything to fall perfectly into place - but will it?

programme.title: Come Dine with Me
programme.desc: Customer services adviser Sarah Wallis is the fourth host in Exeter, and despite holding back all week she hopes to come out of her shell with an evening full of humour. The guests are welcomed in a terrifying manner, before being served some rather unusual cocktails

programme.title: Come Dine with Me
programme.desc: On the final night in Exeter, singleton Estelle Macrow is keen to discover whether she has the ability to successfully host a dinner party. Sarah Wallis, music-mad food connoisseur Richard Kaye, New Zealander Steve Levy and PR bod Glen King await her piece de resistance

programme.title: Four in a Bed
programme.desc: The competition begins at Alston House in Cumbria, where owners Michael and Carole Allchorne are brimming with confidence, but Yvonne Copeland and Gail Wells are less than impressed with the decor. The guests are impressed with chef Michael's breakfast, but the hosts are left reeling by the criticisms levelled at their hotel during the feedback session

programme.title: Four in a Bed
programme.desc: The second visit of the week is to Scotia House in Harrogate, where host Marie Lock is hoping her obsessive cleaning regime will give her the edge in the competition. In the rooms, both Michael and Carole and Yvonne and Gail find the deluxe teddy bears freaky, and for Billy and Billy, things are a little on the cosy side. In the afternoon, Marie's keen to show off her moves and pits her guests against each other in a Northern Soul dance off

programme.title: Four in a Bed
programme.desc: The contestants travel to Canberra Guest House in Blackpool for the third day of the competition, where host Yvonne Copeland, joined by her part-time helper Gail Wells, hopes her cheap and cheerful B&B will win over her guests. However, Marie finds what she thinks is urine and hair on the toilet seat in her room, and a lack of wi-fi means Billy Junior has to put his business on hold. Yvonne takes her competitors to a local reptile house, but serious divisions unfold within the group, and later, tensions rise again at dinner

programme.title: Four in a Bed
programme.desc: The final visit of the week is to the Crown and Kitchen in East Linton, East Lothian, owned by father and son Billy and Billy Jr Robertson, who see themselves as the jokers of the pack. Yvonne and Gail leave no mattress unturned in their room inspection, although Michael and Carole are impressed. Later, Yvonne makes quite a splash when the hosts organise an assault course for their guests, but slow service during breakfast leaves the B&Bers disappointed - especially when Billy Jr is at a loss to explain what the problem was

programme.title: Four in a Bed
programme.desc: The B&B owners meet for the last time to find out what they have been paid and to settle some scores. Things are tense from the start as Carole and Michael from Alston House challenge Marie on her comments. Next, Marie from Scotia House wants to set the record straight with allegations of tit-for-tat scoring. The group members proceed to thrash out their differences before the week's winners are revealed

programme.title: Car S.O.S.
programme.desc: Tim Shaw and Fuzz Townshend head off to Huddersfield, West Yorkshire, to rescue a 1992 VW Corrado, a German coupe that, in its time, was one of the fastest small family cars on the road. The car belongs to 37-year-old Ashley, who even went as far as changing his surname to match his car. Sadly, when Ashley fell ill, his car ended up rotting away under a cover

programme.title: American Pickers
programme.desc: With the roof caving in on his family stockpile, a Kentucky collector's keen to sell whatever he can before it's too late. Which is great news for Mike and Frank because it's a mind-blowing mega-pick!

programme.title: The Dog House
programme.desc: Youngster Harry is hoping to find a best friend who likes to play fetch and Ollie the ball-mad spaniel seems a perfect match. Trini from London is more than ready for a dog in her life, but when sassy fluffball Balloo arrives everything gets thrown in the air. Meanwhile, Roz and John are desperate to help their cockapoo Marnie after she recently lost her sight

programme.title: The Dog House
programme.desc: Two teenage brothers need a peacekeeper but worry that Maggie, a cute Chihuahua cross, hasn't quite the 'look' they are after. Barrie from south Wales has brought his sister Carol for moral support, hoping Bizzy the spaniel can prove to be a great match. Nicola and Matt are a couple with very different dogs in mind - so it's down to Woodgreen to find one lucky pooch they can both agree on

programme.title: Matt Baker: Our Barn in the Dales
programme.desc: Matt Baker and his family transform an old barn, granary and stable beside Matt's parents' farmhouse into a new home of their own. In the first episode, Matt and Nicola begin clearing out decades of memories and belongings, and build a new path after Mike has a fall. But with a sheep needing to be rescued and flocks to feed in the snowy fields, the day-to-day demands of farm life wait for no one

programme.title: 24 Hours in A&E
programme.desc: Cameras follow junior doctor Ming, who for the first time in his career carries out a needle aspiration on a 19-year-old patient brought into A&E with a collapsed lung. A woman who is 17 weeks pregnant falls down the stairs, and fears the accident may lead to a possible miscarriage. She recounts her struggles to conceive, and fears that if this pregnancy fails, she may never have a child

programme.title: 24 Hours in A&E
programme.desc: A London Underground worker undergoes tests to look for signs of a heart attack after collapsing at a Tube station, and recalls the difficulties he faced in his childhood. Doctors work to stabilise the chest and back injuries sustained by a man who fell in his garden, and a Royal Navy veteran comes to A&E with an infected splinter in his arm

programme.title: Strangest Things
programme.desc: The mask of Tutankhamun is one of the most famous finds of ancient Egypt. Close inspection reveals a set of strange marks

programme.title: Abandoned
programme.desc: The team searches the former headquarters of Pabst Brewing Company and finds a blueprint along with a wealth of valuable collectibles

programme.title: Bid & Destroy
programme.desc: The destruction of an old paper mill proves a tough challenge for the crew, and the team members search for valuables to make the effort worthwhile

programme.title: Bid & Destroy
programme.desc: After dangerously undercutting its rivals at auction, the Danley Demolition team tries to salvage valuables from an old boarding house

programme.title: Food Factory
programme.desc: We celebrate Thanksgiving with four holiday favourites: Pepperidge Farms' stuffing, delicious pumpkin pie, crispy marshmallow treats, and cranberry sauce

programme.title: Food Factory
programme.desc: Discover how chili and cheese tamales, frozen tequila margaritas, guacamole-flavoured Guacachips, and citrus polvorones are made

programme.title: When Sharks Attack
programme.desc: The tiny French island of Réunion in the Indian Ocean was once known as a tropical paradise with world-class waves and exceptional diving opportunities. But in 2011, a sudden spike in shark attacks plunges the population into panic. Twenty-three horrifying attacks, including nine fatalities, make Reunion one of the world's deadliest islands. Experts from around the world are brought-in to find a cause - will the islanders get their ocean back?

programme.title: When Sharks Attack
programme.desc: On the Jersey Shore, during the summer of 1916, America's fear of sharks was born. Until this point, sharks had been thought to be harmless fish in the ocean. But during twelve days of terror, the Jersey Shore is painted red with blood, as five people are attacked by sharks. Four of these victims, succumb to their injuries. But what can this historic case teach us about protecting beachgoers, today? Investigators believe they must solve the greatest shark attack mystery of all time... before history repeats itself.

programme.title: Cruise TV with LoveitBookit
programme.desc: Teleshopping feature bringing you the hottest destinations and latest deals to ensure your next cruise is your greatest one

programme.title: Air Crash Investigation
programme.desc: A state-of-the-art helicopter carrying oil workers to a drilling platform crashes into the ocean off the coast of Newfoundland. Remarkably one man survives and within hours, a major recovery effort has begun to retrieve the victims, the flight recorder, and the mangled wreckage from the ocean floor. Investigators piece together the clues and ultimately reveal a fatal flaw in the S-92's design.

programme.title: Air Crash Investigation
programme.desc: A turboprop commuter plane is approaching a remote airport in Papua, Indonesia, when it mysteriously disappears. Billowing smoke on a nearby mountaintop leads search-and-rescue teams to the wreckage. And while three separate systems could have prevented the tragedy, it's up to investigators to figure out why none of them did.

programme.title: Disaster Autopsy
programme.desc: Three real-world disasters forensically analysed and recreated in astonishing detail from expert analysis and all the evidence. Why did Deepwater Horizon explode causing the worst man-made oil spill in history? Why did the Air France Concorde crash barely a minute after take off? How did so many people die in an Austrian funicular trip up the inside of a mountain at Kaprun?

programme.title: Car S.O.S.
programme.desc: Tim Shaw and Fuzz Townshend rescue a 1989 Peugeot 205 GTi that turns out not to be all it purports to be. The car belongs to veterinary surgeon Jeremy, a once-keen amateur rally driver whose racing ambitions were curtailed when his wife developed brain cancer. Former Monte Carlo winner and race legend Paddy Hopkirk joins the team to give Jeremy a day to remember

programme.title: Inside Sydney Airport
programme.desc: Fridays are always busy, with more passengers meaning more problems. Today staff face an air ambulance emergency, security breaches and passenger with illegal drugs

programme.title: Air Crash Investigation
programme.desc: Reconstruction of the 1996 collision between a Kazakhstan Airlines jet and a Saudi Airways plane at 14,000ft, which destroyed both planes and left no survivors. The resultant inquiry attributed the accident to poor communication inside the first plane and outdated radar equipment

programme.title: Hitler's Last Stand
programme.desc: In November 1944, Eisenhower's Broad Front strategy is tested by heavy rains and thick mud which sever supply lines and hinder reinforcements, as British troops arrive to fight on German soil alongside US troops to take the fortified town of Geilenkirchen, a stronghold in Hitler's infamous Siegfried Line.

programme.title: Mega Volcano: Drain the Oceans
programme.desc: The Pacific Ring of Fire is an underwater hotbed of volcanoes, mega-quakes and giant tsunamis. Along its edges, 500 million people live in ever-present danger. Combining CGI with cutting-edge ocean-mapping technology, we drain the Pacific Ocean to reveal the deadly geological forces behind Earth's most destructive natural disasters.

programme.title: How the Tudors Lost Their Heads
programme.desc: Margaret Pole was born into England's ruling dynasty but lost her wealth and status when the Tudors came to power. Resilient and smart, she fought her way back to become one of the country's most powerful people. She was trusted by Henry VIII to be his daughter Mary's governess but was also willing to defy the king. Suzannah Lipscomb and Dan Snow trace Margaret's incredible story and investigate her downfall, exploring castles across England and heading to Europe on the trail of her son, Reginald. A protégé of Henry VIII, he turned against the king over the break with Catholic Rome. Reginald's 'betrayal' led to an international manhunt that endangered his family and eventually led to Margaret's conviction as a traitor. Killed at the age of 67, her execution is remembered as one of the most shocking of Tudor times.

programme.title: Ice Road Rescue
programme.desc: After a truck plunges off a cliff, the recovery teams face fresh challenges as dangerous rescues and a restored tow truck are put to the test

programme.title: Seconds from Disaster
programme.desc: The repercussions of the 1985 Stava Dam collapse in Italy, a disaster that engulfed two villages in a tidal wave of sludge, killing 268 people. A subsequent investigation found the dam was poorly maintained, allowing the pressure within it to build to a catastrophic level

programme.title: Air Crash Investigation
programme.desc: On final approach to Houston, an Amazon cargo plane inexplicably nosedives into a swamp. Surveillance footage and the splintered wreckage confirm a high-speed impact, but investigators can't find any mechanical faults with the plane. The evidence eventually leads them to errors made by a pilot with a well-documented lack of skill who deceived the airline about his troubled past.

programme.title: World War II: The Apocalypse
programme.desc: Footage of battles in Asia, Stalingrad and Egypt, and the implementation of the Final Solution by the Nazis

programme.title: Hitler's Last Stand
programme.desc: Operation Market Gardens' biggest gamble hangs in the balance as paratroopers battle fierce resistance to secure a vital bridge at Nijmegen

programme.title: Nazi Megastructures: Battle Ready
programme.desc: A look at what went into building Hitler's infamous hideouts, including the fortified Wolf's Lair, the Fuhrerbunker and the alpine retreat known as the Eagle's Nest

programme.title: Air Crash Investigation
programme.desc: How the pilots managed to avert an even bigger disaster when the aircraft they were piloting over Sioux City, Iowa, crashed on the airport's runway in July 1989, leaving 111 dead

Resilient and smart, she fought her way back to become one of the country's most powerful people. She was trusted by Henry VIII to be his daughter Mary's governess but was also willing to defy the king. Suzannah Lipscomb and Dan Snow trace Margaret's incredible story and investigate her downfall, exploring castles across England and heading to Europe on the trail of her son, Reginald. A protégé of Henry VIII, he turned against the king over the break with Catholic Rome. Reginald's 'betrayal' led to an international manhunt that endangered his family and eventually led to Margaret's conviction as a traitor. Killed at the age of 67, her execution is remembered as one of the most shocking of Tudor times.

programme.title: Air Crash Investigation
programme.desc: On final approach to Houston, an Amazon cargo plane inexplicably nosedives into a swamp. Surveillance footage and the splintered wreckage confirm a high-speed impact, but investigators can't find any mechanical faults with the plane. The evidence eventually leads them to errors made by a pilot with a well-documented lack of skill who deceived the airline about his troubled past.

programme.title: Antiques Road Trip
programme.desc: Experts Raj Bisram and Irita Marriott explore The Fens in search of treasure, ticking off five east of England counties in their trusty Vanden Plas Princess. As the competition gets down to the pointy end, they apply their business heads on but still cannot resist some shenanigans on the way. At the shops, Raj falls in love with the oldest thing he's ever found on the Road Trip, even if he can't pronounce what's written on the ticket. Irita discovers a secret door barred to the general public and discovers long-forgotten and very dusty treasures

programme.title: The Repair Shop
programme.desc:
Jay Blades and the team bring three treasured family heirlooms, and the memories they hold, back to life.
First to arrive at the barn, seeking the help of conservator Kirsten Ramsay, are Cyndy and Jack Lessing from Essex. They have brought a ceremonial glass goblet, known as a Kiddush cup, which their family used every Friday evening to welcome the Sabbath. Cyndy and Jack bought the ornate, hand-decorated glass over 30 years ago, as a bar mitzvah gift for their son. However, the goblet was smashed in an unfortunate accident and has been kept in pieces in a box for years. Kirsten just hopes they have salvaged every single fragile shard.
Nicole How is next to arrive, with an important piece of London's history for the attention of leather expert Susie Fletcher. The leather bobbin hat is over 100 years old and was worn by Nicole's grandfather during his 43-year career as a porter at Billingsgate Fish Market. He would balance boxes of fish on top of the weighted hat, but now it is dirty and the leather is very tough. Susie is delighted to hear about the charismatic gentleman who owned it and is determined to preserve this wonderful link to a bygone era.
Last, but not least, wood restorer Will Kirk welcomes a wooden push-along horse called Toby. He is accompanied by his proud owner Marjorie Ennew, whose talented grandfather made it for her when she was a toddler. Toby is dearly loved by Marjorie, but she would love Will to fix him up so that he can continue to charm her family. He has lost the handle that pushes him along, his mane is long gone, and he is very chipped in places. Will, of course, is more than happy to oblige.

programme.title: Salvage Hunters: The Restorers

programme.title: Great Continental Railway Journeys
programme.desc: Michael Portillo ventures once more on to the European rail network to retrace journeys featured in George Bradshaw's 1913 publication Continental Guide, beginning by travelling through Russia. He starts in the industrial city of Tula, before visiting Leo Tolstoy's former home of Yasnaya Polyana and learning how the author's life and works were intertwined with the railways. Michael then boards the train that runs from the Caspian Sea to Moscow, where he performs an important role in a dramatic opera at the Bolshoi Theatre, before exploring the beauty and history of St Petersburg and riding on the first railway ever built in Russia

programme.desc:
Today, Andrew Denly and wife Sheila from Sussex are hoping clockmaker Steve Fletcher can fix a vintage boy's toy with big memories attached. It's an antique toy cannon handed down to Andrew by his grandfather, who bought it with his pocket money in 1907. Andrew fondly describes his grandfather as his inspiration and boyhood hero. The little cannon is much treasured but hasn't worked in over 50 years. Steve must use all his ingenuity to get it firing once more.
A Victorian oddity is brought to the attention of leather expert Susie Fletcher. Sisters Pam and Frances are hoping Suzie can revive a novelty inkwell in the shape of a hat. It is a treasured family heirloom as it had huge sentimental value to the sisters' mother. After years of vigorous overuse, the button mechanism no longer works and it is missing its leather covering. Suzie drafts in sibling Steve Fletcher to help make a missing part, and she discovers a new talent for miniature millinery as she returns the inkwell to its stylish former glory.
Finally, ceramics expert Kirstin Ramsey prays for divine intervention as she tries to rebuild a saintly statue. Caroline Morson and Professor John Northover have come to the barn seeking help resurrecting an important icon that's been a symbol of hope to many: a statue of St Fiacre, the patron saint of gardeners and haemorrhoid victims! The statue has been a landmark in the garden of St Mark's Hospital, a centre for the treatment of bowel disease, for many years, but has been vandalised and is now broken in two. Gifted to the hospital by Caroline's father, renowned pathologist Dr Basil Morson, staff and patients alike are keen to see St Fiacre restored and back on duty. By far one of the biggest projects Kirsten has had on her bench, she must clean and reunite the two large broken halves, creating an imperceptible join to breathe new life into this old saint.
