programme.desc: When a lethal contagious fungus escapes a secret lab, two young employees, joined by a grizzled bioterror operative, must survive the wildest night shift ever. Director Jonny Campbell's comedy thriller, starring Joe Keery, Georgina Campbell, Liam Neeson and Lesley Manville

programme.title: Mother's Pride
programme.desc: A grieving family who own a failing pub have their lives changed by brewing real ale and entering the Great British Beer Awards. Comedy, starring Martin Clunes, James Buckley and Miles Jupp

programme.title: Better Man
programme.desc: Biographical drama charting the meteoric rise, dramatic fall and remarkable resurgence of British pop icon, Robbie Williams

programme.title: Kiss of the Spider Woman
programme.desc: Political prisoner Valentín shares a cell with Molina, convicted for public indecency, where an unlikely bond forms between the pair as the latter recounts a glamorous Hollywood movie. Adaptation of the stage musical, based on the novel by Manuel Puig, starring Diego Luna, Jennifer Lopez and Tonatiuh

programme.title: Scream 7
programme.desc: Sidney Prescott-Evans, one of the survivors of the original Ghostface killers, has built a new life in the quiet town of Pine Grove, far from Woodsboro, with her 17-year-old daughter Tatum. A lethal new stalker emerges with a diabolical plan that involves targeting Tatum and everyone that Sidney loves. Horror sequel, starring Neve Campbell, Courteney Cox and Isabel May

programme.title: Mexicali
programme.desc: Former fighter Joe helps run a Mexican farm with his partner, Estrella. After entering underground bouts to support the workers, he is ambushed by a gang and forced to fight for his life. Action thriller, starring Bren Foster and Tania Raymonde

programme.title: Jumanji: The Next Level
programme.desc: Fantasy adventure sequel starring Dwayne Johnson, Jack Black, Kevin Hart and Karen Gillan. Two years after the events of Jumanji: Welcome to the Jungle, the teenagers must return to the magical video game to rescue one of their own. But when they get there, the players are baffled to find that everything about the game - and themselves - has changed.

programme.title: Peter Rabbit
programme.desc: Part-animated fantasy featuring the voice of James Corden, and starring Rose Byrne and Domhnall Gleeson. Peter Rabbit and his family take great pleasure in stealing vegetables from the garden of crotchety old Mr McGregor. But when the old man unexpectedly dies and his nephew inherits his home, Peter and co are confronted with a formidable new foe.

programme.title: Matilda
programme.desc: Comic fantasy based on the book by Roald Dahl, starring Mara Wilson and Danny DeVito. Matilda, the daughter of Harry and Zinnia Wormwood, has adored reading from a precociously early age, but her parents refuse to let her go to school. Until, that is, her father sends her to the unforgiving Miss Trunchbull's Crunchem Hall, where she discovers that she has other more useful gifts.

programme.title: Look Who's Talking Too
programme.desc: Comedy sequel to the blockbuster Look Who's Talking, starring John Travolta and Kirstie Alley. Mikey is still trying to cope with the trials of potty training when he is presented with another bombshell: he is to get a sister. And, as if that wasn't enough, relations between his parents James and Mollie aren't going so well, either.

programme.title: Gabby's Dollhouse: The Movie
programme.desc: When Gabby's prized dollhouse ends up with eccentric cat lady Vera, the youngster embarks on a adventure to reunite the Gabby Cats and retrieve her beloved diorama before it's too late. Comedy adventure, starring Laila Lockhart Kraner and Kristen Wiig

programme.title: Yogi Bear
programme.desc: Part-animated comedy adventure featuring the voices of Dan Aykroyd and Justin Timberlake. Jellystone Park's famous talking bear Yogi and his sidekick Boo Boo find their home under threat from a spendthrift mayor who has plans to sell it off.

programme.title: Goosebumps
programme.desc: Horror comedy based on the popular books by R L Stine, starring Jack Black. When 15-year-old Zach breaks into his neighbour's house to investigate strange noises, he discovers that he lives next door to the author of the Goosebumps series, whose monstrous creations have to be kept in locked manuscripts. But when the monsters get loose, it's up to Zach to help imprison them again.

programme.title: Goosebumps 2: Haunted Halloween
programme.desc: Two youngsters unwittingly unleash all manner of monsters from a locked manuscript they find in an abandoned house. Comedy sequel, starring Madison Iseman, Jeremy Ray Taylor and Wendy McLendon-Covey

programme.title: Wicked: For Good
programme.desc: Elphaba, the Wicked Witch of the West, must reunite with Glinda the Good to transform herself - and Oz. Fantasy sequel based on the hit musical, starring Cynthia Erivo, Ariana Grande and Jeff Goldblum

programme.title: A Minecraft Movie
programme.desc: Four misfits are yanked through a strange portal into a cubic realm powered by imagination. To return home, they must learn its rules and journey alongside an unlikely master crafter. Director Jared Hess's blockbusting fantasy adventure based on the hit videogame, starring Jack Black, Jason Momoa, Emma Myers and Jennifer Coolidge

programme.title: Johnny English
programme.desc: Comedy adventure starring Rowan Atkinson, and featuring John Malkovich. When the crown jewels are stolen from under the nose of the authorities, bumbling secret agent Johnny English is assigned to retrieve them and capture the culprits. The unfortunate spy is soon in over his head when he discovers that the theft is part of an evil plan to seize the British throne.

programme.title: Bean
programme.desc: Comedy starring Rowan Atkinson as the accident-prone Mr Bean. In an attempt to get rid of him from his job as one of their attendants, the governors of the National Gallery send Mr Bean to America to represent them at the unveiling of the Grierson Gallery's new purchase. Needless to say disaster is never far away.

programme.title: Mr Bean's Holiday
programme.desc: Comedy starring Rowan Atkinson. Mr Bean puts the entente cordiale under considerable strain when he wins a camcorder and a trip to France in a raffle. After a typically accident-prone encounter with a Russian film director, the hapless hero ends up at the Cannes film festival.

programme.title: Wicked: For Good
programme.desc: Elphaba, the Wicked Witch of the West, must reunite with Glinda the Good to transform herself - and Oz. Fantasy sequel based on the hit musical, starring Cynthia Erivo, Ariana Grande and Jeff Goldblum

programme.title: Mr Bean's Holiday
programme.desc: Comedy starring Rowan Atkinson. Mr Bean puts the entente cordiale under considerable strain when he wins a camcorder and a trip to France in a raffle. After a typically accident-prone encounter with a Russian film director, the hapless hero ends up at the Cannes film festival.

programme.title: Dumb and Dumberer: When Harry Met Lloyd
programme.desc: Prequel to the Jim Carrey/Jeff Daniels comedy Dumb and Dumber, starring Eric Christian Olsen and Derek Richardson. Dumbo duo Lloyd and Harry meet in their teens and inadvertently foil a fund-embezzling plot by their high-school principal.

programme.title: The Deb
programme.desc: A young farmer hopes a debutante ball will transform her life. Her city cousin arrives after being expelled from school and scoffs at the traditions. As they search for dates, the teenagers challenge each other's assumptions. Comedy musical, starring Natalie Abbott, Charlotte MacInnes, and Rebel Wilson, who also directed

programme.title: The Cinema List: Remakes (2026)
programme.desc: It's time to kick off your Sunday shoes with remakes in this edition of the Cinema List. From Footloose to The Italian Job, revisit familiar favourites with a fresh twist

programme.title: Anchorman: The Legend of Ron Burgundy
programme.desc: Period comedy starring Will Ferrell. Ron Burgundy is the top newsreader at a San Diego TV station in the 1970s. But his position comes under threat with the arrival of ambitious reporter Veronica Corningstone. Male chauvinist Burgundy is torn between defending his job and his attraction to the glamorous newcomer.

programme.title: Shaun of the Dead
programme.desc: Comedy horror starring Simon Pegg and Nick Frost. On the day north London slacker Shaun decides to sort his life out, the dead rise and the city becomes overrun with zombies. Can Shaun and best mate Ed fight off the marauding hordes of the undead and win back Shaun's girlfriend? Or will they just go down the pub?

programme.title: American Pie: The Wedding
programme.desc: Comedy starring Jason Biggs and Alyson Hannigan. After pursuing each other through two movies, Jim and Michelle finally decide to tie the knot, but their friends' plans for a bachelor party almost derail the forthcoming nuptials.

programme.title: Anaconda
programme.desc: Best friends Doug and Griff became obsessed with the film Anaconda when they were children and have always dreamed of remaking their favourite picture. When both men find themselves in the grip of a mid-life crisis, they fast track their film-making ambitions and head into the Amazon jungle with pals Claire and Kenny to shoot their slithering masterpiece. Comedy adventure, starring Jack Black, Paul Rudd and Thandiwe Newton

programme.title: Pitch Perfect 3
programme.desc: Musical comedy starring Anna Kendrick and Rebel Wilson. Having graduated from college, the Bellas reunite for one last harmonised hurrah in the form of an overseas tour.

programme.title: Nirvanna the Band the Show the Movie
programme.desc: When a scheme to book a show at a local nightspot goes disastrously wrong, Toronto musicians Matt and Jay are unexpectedly transported back to 2008. Fantasy comedy, starring Matt Johnson and Jay McCarrol

programme.title: Instant Family
programme.desc: Comedy drama starring Mark Wahlberg, Rose Byrne and Isabela Moner. Childless couple Pete and Ellie Wagner decide to adopt, and are drawn to talented but troubled teenager Lizzy. When it turns out that Lizzy comes with two younger siblings, the prospective parents take in the whole brood - an act of kindness that soon proves overwhelming.

programme.title: Ace Ventura: When Nature Calls
programme.desc: Comedy starring Jim Carrey. Ace Ventura is traced to a Tibetan monastery by British diplomats, who want him to recover a stolen sacred Great White Bat in order to prevent a tribal war breaking out in Africa.

programme.title: Mother's Pride
programme.desc: A grieving family who own a failing pub have their lives changed by brewing real ale and entering the Great British Beer Awards. Comedy, starring Martin Clunes, James Buckley and Miles Jupp

programme.title: Nirvanna the Band the Show the Movie
programme.desc: When a scheme to book a show at a local nightspot goes disastrously wrong, Toronto musicians Matt and Jay are unexpectedly transported back to 2008. Fantasy comedy, starring Matt Johnson and Jay McCarrol

programme.title: Anaconda

When both men find themselves in the grip of a mid-life crisis, they fast track their film-making ambitions and head into the Amazon jungle with pals Claire and Kenny to shoot their slithering masterpiece. Comedy adventure, starring Jack Black, Paul Rudd and Thandiwe Newton

programme.title: Women of World War II: More Untold Stories
programme.desc: With rare archival footage and revealing interviews, this documentary tells the unknown stories of the women who enabled Allied victory in the Second World War. It honours their accomplishments with moving tributes from the history-makers and people they inspired.

programme.title: Weathered: Earth's Extremes
programme.desc: Maiya May explores heat in Portland, Oregon, and Medellín, Colombia, a city that is leading the revolution against sweltering city temperatures before visiting the hottest city in the US, Phoenix, Arizona

programme.title: Teleshopping
programme.desc: A chance for viewers to purchase goods from the comfort of home

programme.title: Teleshopping
programme.desc: A chance for viewers to purchase goods from the comfort of home

programme.title: Weathered: Earth's Extremes
programme.desc: Maiya May goes to Cheyenne to visit a supercomputer. In Michigan, she observes the explosive end of a coal plant. Returning to Atlanta, Maiya and Dr Marshall Shepard discuss climate challenges and vulnerabilities in the United States

programme.title: The Siege of Leningrad
programme.desc: The 872-day German and Finnish encirclement of the Soviet city between September 1941 and January 1944, which saw its inhabitants falling into despair, starvation and cannibalism. This documentary features extensive interviews with historian Anna Reid, while eyewitnesses recall the dramatic events. Original diaries and documents, along with rarely seen film and photographic material, illustrate the tragedy

programme.title: Victorian Britain on Film
programme.desc: Documentary offering a unique window into a bygone era when a thrilling new invention, the motion picture camera, first captured a nation on film. Most of these films have been transformed by colourising them for the first time. They offer a rare portrait of a powerful and prosperous nation - and Empire - on the cusp of great change

programme.title: Edwardian Britain in Colour
programme.desc: Part one of a two-part documentary in which social historians examine surviving film footage of Britain in the early years of the 20th century. The first episode features footage of Queen Victoria's state funeral in 1901 and a bicycle parade celebrating the coronation of the new king. The programme also examines life for people employed in the mining and cotton industries, as well as how an increase in leisure time led to the the popularity of seaside resorts soaring, with Blackpool leading the way

programme.title: Edwardian Britain in Colour
programme.desc: Conclusion of the two-part documentary in which social historians examine surviving footage of Britain in the early years of the 20th century. This edition featuring clips of people celebrating the arrival of a new tram in Wigan, a football match in Burnley, and a public swimming gala in Tynemouth, and film of suffragette Emily Wilding Davison colliding with the king's horse at the 1913 Epsom Derby

programme.title: Waco: The Longest Siege
programme.desc: Documentary uncovering the unexplored stories of the longest stand-off in American history, when religious sect Branch Davidians resisted US authorities to enter its compound between February 28 and April 19, 1993. This unique documentary tells the story of David Koresh's rise from obscurity to become the prophet and leader of the religious sect

This unique documentary tells the story of David Koresh's rise from obscurity to become the prophet and leader of the religious sect

programme.title: The Brutalist
programme.desc: Epic period drama starring Adrien Brody, Felicity Jones and Guy Pearce. In 1947, Hungarian architect and Holocaust survivor László Tóth arrives in America. After a rocky start in this new land, he finds his luck changing when he meets a wealthy industrialist who wants László to build an ambitious community project. However, for the tormented László and his wife, Erzsébet, this commission proves both blessing and curse.

programme.title: Stand By Me
programme.desc: Coming-of-age drama, based on a story by Stephen King, starring Wil Wheaton and River Phoenix. A writer looks back on his childhood in late-1950s Oregon, in particular the time when he and his friends set out to find the corpse of a boy believed to have been hit by a train.

programme.title: The Friend
programme.desc: When a solitary writer adopts and bonds with a Great Dane that belonged to a late friend, she begins to come to terms with her past and her own creative inner life. Drama based on the novel by Sigrid Nunez, starring Naomi Watts and Bill Murray

programme.title: Tommy
programme.desc: Ken Russell's satirical adaptation of the rock opera written by Pete Townshend and the Who, starring Roger Daltrey, Oliver Reed and Ann-Margret. A few months after her husband goes missing during the Second World War, Nora Walker gives birth to a son whom she names Tommy. Later, the boy is rendered deaf, dumb and blind and all efforts to cure Tommy fail. However, his life is transformed when he discovers pinball.

programme.title: Love Me
programme.desc: A buoy and a satellite meet online and fall in love after the end of human civilisation. Award-winning drama written and directed by Sam Zuchero and Andrew Zuchero, starring Steven Yeun and Kristen Stewart

programme.title: Better Man
programme.desc: Biographical drama charting the meteoric rise, dramatic fall and remarkable resurgence of British pop icon, Robbie Williams

programme.title: Terms of Endearment
programme.desc: Oscar-winning melodrama starring Shirley MacLaine, Debra Winger and Jack Nicholson. Aurora Greenway is an attractive widow whose main problems in life are fending off an alarming number of suitors and keeping her headstrong daughter Emma in check. But as the years pass by, Aurora's attitude to life and love, and her relationship with her daughter, begin to change.

programme.title: Valentine's Day
programme.desc: Romantic comedy featuring an ensemble cast including Anne Hathaway, Jessica Alba and Julia Roberts. The love life of a florist working on Valentine's Day is sent into a tailspin after he proposes to his girlfriend. Meanwhile, his best friend thinks she has met the man of her dreams, little realising he is already married. Will love lend a hand and save the day?

programme.title: Grease
programme.desc: Musical based on the hit stage show, starring John Travolta and Olivia Newton-John. Unexpectedly reunited with summer love Danny at her new high school, Sandy Olsson can't believe how different he is. Can the new Danny Zuko, the leather-clad, tough-talking leader of the T-birds, really be the boy she met down at the beach? Perhaps Frenchy and Rizzo, both members of the super-cool Pink Ladies gang, can help her develop some street cred to win back his heart.

programme.title: Jerry Maguire
programme.desc: Romantic comedy starring Tom Cruise, Cuba Gooding Jr and Renee Zellweger. As a top agent at Sports Management International, Jerry Maguire knows his way around and is his own man... until one day he gets an attack of decency and finds himself out of a job. Now he must start from scratch. His only allies are a single mother, her cheeky young son and a second-rate player for the Arizona Cardinals.

programme.title: Bohemian Rhapsody
programme.desc: Biographical music drama starring Rami Malek. London, 1970: living with his parents, Farrokh Bulsara dreams of becoming a rock star. So when local group Smile loses its lead singer, he convinces guitarist Brian May and drummer Roger Taylor to give him a shot. With the addition of bassist John Deacon and Bulsara changing his name to Freddie Mercury, the band Queen is born - but the path to world domination is a bumpy one.

programme.title: Terms of Endearment
programme.desc: Oscar-winning melodrama starring Shirley MacLaine, Debra Winger and Jack Nicholson. Aurora Greenway is an attractive widow whose main problems in life are fending off an alarming number of suitors and keeping her headstrong daughter Emma in check. But as the years pass by, Aurora's attitude to life and love, and her relationship with her daughter, begin to change.

programme.title: The Alto Knights
programme.desc: Two rivals fight for control of a major crime family. Director Barry Levinson's drama based on true events, starring Robert De Niro, Cosmo Jarvis and Debra Messing

programme.title: Strung
programme.desc: A talented violinist whose new job tutoring for an elite family turns into a battle for safety and sanity when she realises her past is linked to the family's patriarch. Thriller, starring Chloe Bailey, Lynn Whitfield and Lucien Laviscount

programme.title: Detroit
programme.desc: Drama based on a true story, starring John Boyega. During the US summer riots of 1967, a gang of police officers raid Detroit's Algiers Motel and proceed to terrorise its mostly Black residents.

programme.title: Clear and Present Danger
programme.desc: Political thriller starring Harrison Ford and Willem Dafoe. When Jack Ryan is asked to investigate the murder of a friend of the US President, he finds himself up against not only a Colombian drugs cartel but also corrupt American government officials.

programme.title: Nightcrawler
programme.desc: Crime drama starring Jake Gyllenhaal, Rene Russo and Riz Ahmed. Los Angeles loner Louis Bloom makes a living hustling, until one night he observes a freelance news photographer taking photos of a horrific car accident. Inspired by this nocturnal, dog-eat-dog world of "nightcrawling", Bloom buys a video camera and spends his evenings in pursuit of accidents, robberies and fire scenes. However, as Bloom's scoops earn ever-more lucrative payment from local news stations, the line between reporting news and becoming part of it becomes dangerously blurred.

programme.title: Red Dragon
programme.desc: Thriller based on the Thomas Harris novel that introduced Hannibal Lecter, starring Anthony Hopkins, Edward Norton and Ralph Fiennes.Called out of retirement to help track a serial killer known as "The Tooth Fairy", detective Will Graham is forced to turn to his old enemy, the imprisoned Lecter, to help him build a psychological profile of the killer. But as the case develops, the line between who is controlling whom becomes blurred.

programme.title: No Country for Old Men
programme.desc: Oscar-winning crime thriller from the Coen brothers, starring Tommy Lee Jones, Javier Bardem and Josh Brolin. After going on the run with $2 million from a botched desert drugs deal, hapless cowboy Llewelyn Moss is pursued across Texas by sociopathic hitman Anton Chigurh and ageing sheriff Ed Tom Bell.

programme.title: Snatch
programme.desc: Comedy crime drama starring Brad Pitt, Jason Statham and Benicio Del Toro. In Antwerp, jewel thief Franky Four Fingers steals a huge diamond, but before he can deliver it to his New York boss he is ambushed in London by a Russian mobster's henchmen. Elsewhere in the capital, crimelord Brick Top demands that Irish boxer Mickey One Punch take a dive in an unlicensed fight. When Brick Top joins the hunt for the missing gem, mayhem ensues.

programme.title: Civil War
programme.desc: Action drama starring Kirsten Dunst, Wagner Moura and Cailee Spaeny. The USA is ravaged by civil war. Documenting the atrocities, a group of journalists - including veteran photographer Lee, reporter Joel and rookie Jessie - travel from New York to Washington DC to interview the President before armed secessionist militias reach the capital.

programme.title: The Bank Job
programme.desc: Heist thriller based on a true story, starring Jason Statham and Saffron Burrows. In 1970s London, Terry Leather, a car dealer with a dubious past, is approached by his glamorous former girlfriend Martine. She has a plan to steal safe deposit boxes from a top bank, and needs his help to organise the robbery. But the boxes contain more than just valuables, and Terry discovers that several dangerous individuals also want to get hold of them.

programme.title: Safe House
programme.desc: Action thriller starring Ryan Reynolds and Denzel Washington. Junior agent Matt Weston runs the CIA's sleepy safe house in South Africa and is suddenly handed a hot assignment when a rogue agent decides to give himself up after years on the run. Little does Weston know how dangerous things are going to get...

programme.title: Hungry
programme.desc: After becoming lost in the Louisiana swamplands, a group of holiday-makers must fight for their lives against a rampaging hippo on the loose. Horror thriller, starring Madison Davenport and Tracey Bonner

programme.title: Basic Instinct
programme.desc: Erotic thriller starring Michael Douglas and Sharon Stone. After a former rock star is brutally murdered with an ice pick, San Francisco detective Nick Curran interviews Catherine Tramell, the star's novelist girlfriend, whose last book contained an identical killing. Curran, who is trying to reform his excessive lifestyle with the help of a police psychologist, soon becomes dangerously involved with his key suspect.

programme.title: The 7th Voyage of Sinbad
programme.desc: Fantasy adventure starring Kerwin Mathews. Blown off course to the monster-infested island of Colossa, Sinbad and his crew rescue a sorcerer from the clutches of a cyclops. The voyage continues to Baghdad, but the sorcerer has been forced to leave stolen property behind, and hatches a wicked plan to force Sinbad to return to Colossa.

programme.title: Logan's Run
programme.desc: Science-fiction thriller starring Michael York and Jenny Agutter. In the 23rd century, people live under vast domes in a world with no disease, hunger or greed. But nobody is allowed to live past 30 without going through a ritual called "renewal", where only a few survive.

programme.title: The Pursuit of Happiness
programme.desc: A student driver lands himself in trouble with the police after hitting a pedestrian, and finds his aggressive attitude only makes matters worse. Drama, starring Barbara Hershey, Michael Sarrazin, Arthur Hill and EG Marshall

programme.title: True Grit
programme.desc: Oscar-winning western starring John Wayne as one-eyed US marshal "Rooster" Cogburn. When a young girl discovers that her father has been robbed and murdered, she persuades the hard-drinking Cogburn to track down the killer.

programme.title: Shenandoah
programme.desc: Western starring James Stewart and Doug McClure. Loner Charlie Anderson keeps his family out of the Civil War, even though there is fighting a few miles from his Virginia farm. But when his new son-in-law joins the Confederate army and his youngest son is captured by Federal troops, Charlie finds he can no longer ignore the conflict.

programme.title: Robin Hood: Prince of Thieves
programme.desc: Action adventure starring Kevin Costner, Mary Elizabeth Mastrantonio, Alan Rickman and Morgan Freeman. After escaping from prison in the Holy Land, Robin of Locksley and his friend Azeem return to England, where they discover Robin's father murdered and King Richard exiled. When they meet a band of thieves in the woods, they join forces to try to oust the wicked Sheriff of Nottingham.

programme.title: Lake Placid
programme.desc: Adventure thriller starring Bill Pullman, Bridget Fonda and Oliver Platt. After a diver is killed while trawling Black Lake in northern Maine, an unusual tooth is pulled from the body. New York palaeontologist Kelly Scott identifies the tooth as coming from a giant crocodile, and joins Sheriff Hank Keough, game warden Jack Wells and mythology expert Hector Cyr in a quest to catch the creature.

programme.title: Anaconda
programme.desc: Horror adventure starring Jennifer Lopez, Ice Cube and Jon Voight. In the Amazon jungle, a documentary crew rescues a loner who turns out to be a man obsessed. Life becomes dangerous for them all as he attempts to capture a lethal 40ft anaconda...

programme.title: Jaws
programme.desc: Steven Spielberg's classic adventure thriller, starring Roy Scheider, Robert Shaw and Richard Dreyfuss. The Atlantic resort of Amity Island is preparing for its lucrative summer season when death strikes in the form of a Great White shark. Rather than turn away business, Mayor Vaughn orders police chief Brody to keep the beaches open.

programme.title: Jaws 2
programme.desc: Sequel to Steven Spielberg's blockbuster, starring Roy Scheider as police chief Martin Brody, who fears that a great white shark is once again threatening the holiday resort of Amity. But with the summer season under way, Brody has a tough job convincing Amity's business community of the danger.

programme.title: Jaws 3
programme.desc: Action adventure starring Dennis Quaid and Louis Gossett Jr. Sheriff Brody's sons are working at a new marine park, where a captive infant great white shark is being groomed as the centre's latest tourist attraction. However, no one has reckoned on the creature's vengeful mother.

programme.title: Goodfellas
programme.desc: Martin Scorsese's crime drama, starring Robert De Niro, Ray Liotta and Joe Pesci. In 1950s New York, Irish-Italian schoolboy Henry Hill dreams of becoming a gangster and lands a job parking cars for the Mob. Having earned the respect of the local Mafia boss, he is teamed with hitmen James Conway and Tommy DeVito. But as the years pass, Hill finds his allegiance to the Mob challenged as he descends deeper into organised crime.

programme.title: Driven to Kill
programme.desc: Action thriller starring Steven Seagal as a former Russian gangster who has turned over a new leaf as a crime novelist. But he's forced to confront his violent past when his daughter decides to marry the son of an old enemy.

programme.title: Man of Tai Chi
programme.desc: A rebellious martial arts expert competes in an underground fighting circuit so he can raise money to save his temple. However, he risks corrupting his spirit as he is drawn further down the path of violence, while the organisers of the arena have their own sinister plans for him. programme.title: Alita: Battle Angel
programme.desc: Science-fiction action adventure starring Rosa Salazar and Christoph Waltz. On a future Earth, Dr Dyson Ido reawakens a dormant cyborg and names her "Alita". As the awkward encounter unfolds, the actors repeatedly break character, revealing they're filming an AI-directed movie, where on-set tensions, personal anxieties and reality increasingly blur with the fictional romantic drama. programme.title: The Bridge on the River Kwai
programme.desc: Second World War epic starring Alec Guinness, William Holden and Jack Hawkins. Despite being held in a Japanese PoW camp in Burma, Colonel Nicholson still runs his regiment by the military textbook. However, Nicholson meets his match in the equally stubborn prison commander Colonel Saito, and the two find themselves on a collision course when Saito gets orders to build a strategically important railway bridge.

As the fighting intensifies, it soon becomes clear the crews are fighting for the survival of the Earth itself.

programme.title: Lisa Frankenstein
programme.desc: Romantic comedy horror starring Kathryn Newton and Cole Sprouse. As a child, Lisa Swallows was traumatised when she witnessed the murder of her mother. Now a teenage outsider, she fantasises about a Victorian gentleman whose grave she tends. When a lightning strike reanimates his corpse, she helps him to heal by gathering together the body parts he is missing - which she chooses to "acquire" from her mortal enemies.

programme.title: Go Jetters
programme.desc:
Xuli and Foz are in the Vroomster - but this time Foz is at the controls on a flying lesson. The pair have a rough landing in a tulip field in the Netherlands. Luckily the Vroomster doesn't have a scratch on it. Foz and Xuli are impressed with the tulip fields. Lars, Kyan and Ubercorn join over comms - it reminds Kyan of a rainbow! They all plan to meet up at the Flower Parade later.
Meanwhile Glitch is in a nearby barn, instructing the Grimbots to fetch more tulips for a giant float which looks just like Glitch! Xuli and Foz spot a Grimbot driving a harvester, which is tearing up tons of tulips and rush to the Vroomster to stop it. Xuli flies the Vroomster to the harvester and Foz jumps aboard. The Grimbot insists he has permission to cut all the flowers but Foz doesn't believe it and tries to wrestle the steering wheel from the Grimbot.
Xuli heads to the barn and discovers Glitch, Tala and Johan the flower farmer happily assembling Glitch's statue. It turns out Johan has given permission for Glitch and Tala to use the flowers to build their float - whoops! There isn't a Glitch after all and the Go Jetters have made a mistake.
Foz spots a big button in the harvester. He leans in to push it, the Grimbot notices at the last second and tries to stop him but it's too late. Foz presses the button, and both Foz and the Grimbot are ejected from the harvester and fall into a mud pile - they're stuck fast! Xuli, Tala and Glitch have run out of the barn to see the driverless harvester coming straight towards them. Xuli calls up Click Ons for her and Tala - they use G.O shield to redirect the harvester to stop it crashing into the barn. It works - but now the harvester is on course to hit the greenhouses! Xuli and Tala turn to see Glitch appear from out of the Grimbler - he has his Grim Mag on, ready to save the day. But Glitch is pulled towards the metal harvester and Xuli is dragged with them too - Grimbles!
Foz manages to free himself from the mud and flies the Vroomster to catch up with the harvester, Glitch and Xuli. After a few failed attempts Foz manages to nudge the harvester off course and away from the greenhouse; the workers are safe. But now the out of control machine is heading towards some Grimbots which are still stuck in the mud. Tala drives the float between the Grimbots and the harvester, ready to sacrifice her hard work to save her Uncle's precious Grimbots. Foz summons all his new found flying skills and manages to lift the harvester; freeing Xuli and Glitch and saving the flower float in the nick of time. With everyone saved they head to the flower parade where Foz puts his new-found driving skills to good use by driving Tala and Glitch's beautiful float.

programme.desc:
When Professor Squawkencluck's seriousizer ray is nabbed by Pompom, the fun-and laughter-hating president of the clown planet of Bozoria, Danger Mouse teams up with his clown-shaped Bozorian equivalent Cupcake in order to foil whatever dastardly plan is afoot. As it turns out, Pompom intends to use the ray to strip Bozoria of all things amusing, and he kidnaps Squawkencluck and exploits her extreme fear of clowns to coerce her into unlocking the seriousizer's technology.
Danger Mouse and Penfold go native as they disguise themselves as clowns to infiltrate Popmpom's Bozorian lair alongside Cupcake. However, they're too late to stop Squawk spilling the beans on the organic matter that powers her seriousizer invention - brussels sprouts!
With Danger Mouse and Penfold in chains stomping brussels sprouts, Squawkencluck finds herself in the uncomfortable position of being confined to a laboratory with Cupcake, after Pompom orders the pair to get to work on replicating the seriousizer technology. Squawk's anxiety melts away as Cupcake introduces her to Clown Science, and the pair bond before coming up with a plan to secretly turn the seriousizer into a ridiculator.
Pompom's hopes of turning Bozoria into a land of dullery and boringness are well and truly dashed when he finds that the ridiculator has the opposite effect and makes the population even sillier. Having broken free, Danger Mouse and Penfold unite with Squawkencluck and Cupcake in time to take Pompom into 'custardy'.

programme.title: Royal Births, Marriages & Deaths
programme.desc: The story of a thousand years of monarchy told through milestones of royal families through the ages,, beginning by looking at the death and funeral of Queen Victoria, with biographer Shrabani Basu, author Stewart Richards and historian Lisa Hilton piecing together what went on behind palace walls. Historian Kate Williams tells the story of George IV, whose catastrophic wedding to Caroline of Brunswick went ahead even though he'd already illegally 'married' his mistress a decade before

programme.title: Royal Births, Marriages & Deaths
programme.desc: A look at the wedding of Princess Elizabeth and Prince Philip in 1947, which lifted spirits in bleak post-war Britain, with historian Lisa Hilton delving into the royal archives to dig out the wedding menu. Biographers Andrew Morton and Andrew Lownie take viewers through the birth and christening of the Duke and Duchess of Sussex's son Prince Archie, while Kate Williams examines the life of Mary, Queen of Scots

programme.title: Secrets of the Royal Traditions
programme.desc: The origins of traditions used by the royal family for hundreds or thousands of years, beginning with some of those on display at Queen Elizabeth's funeral in September 2022, as well the secrets of other lighter and sometimes humorous conventions. From the history of the royal vigil at the coffin in Westminster Hall to the tradition of royals unveiling plaques for everything from train Lines to blocks of flats, these are the rituals that keep the royals in the public spotlight

programme.title: Secrets of the Royal Traditions
programme.desc: The history of state visits, in which the royal family are given a chance to use all the traditions at their disposal to champion Britain on the world stage, from banquets and public processions to multiple gun salutes. The programme also reveals the secrets of more everyday conventions, including how royal make-up can send powerful messages of defiance, to the successes and failures of royal statues through the centuries

programme.title: The Royals Uncensored
programme.desc: Katie Nicholl and Jo Elvin present debate, insider analysis and insights on the royal family, with regular contributions from the King's former butler Grant Harrold and a host of authors, experts and commentators from around the world

programme.title: Spain with Michael Portillo
programme.desc: Michael travels to Mallorca, starting in the capital Palma, where he heads to the top of its cathedral. Later he goes to the north, once almost cut off from the rest of Mallorca by the towering Tramontana mountains. With the help of a new road tunnel, Michael reveals how the beautiful town of Soller made its fortune from selling citrus fruit to the French during the 19th and 20th centuries

programme.title: Spain with Michael Portillo
programme.desc: Michael journeys through Andalucía to uncover Almería, an often-overlooked city once central to Spain's film industry. From the vast Alcazaba fortress and its Islamic gardens to the city's iconic pink Americano drink, he traces Moorish influence and cinematic history. He explores Spaghetti Western film sets, and learns to bar brawl with a professional stuntman. Michael also visits a cave lined with clear crystals, spends the night in Cabo de Gata, and dances the fandango

programme.title: The South Pole with Ben Fogle
programme.desc: Ben and Dwayne Fields tackle the trials and tribulations faced by the expeditions racing to become the first to reach the South pole at the beginning of the 20th century. The duo step back in time to wear the clothes, eat the food and use the same kit as their Edwardian heroes Scott, Shackleton and Amundsen

programme.title: 5 News Weekend
programme.desc: National and international news

programme.title: Mary Celeste: Solving the Mystery
programme.desc: For more than 150 years, the mystery of the "ghost ship" Mary Celeste has baffled the world. Why was a perfectly sound ship apparently abandoned mid-voyage? What happened to its crew? Conspiracy theories have pointed to pirates, mutiny and sea monsters, but now, science can provide a definitive answer. At the heart of this film is a large-scale lab experiment led by chemist Dr Andrea Sella, revealing how a powerful but non-destructive explosion, caused by leaking alcohol cargo, could have terrified the crew into abandoning ship

programme.title: Killer Storm: The Fastnet Disaster of '79
programme.desc: Documentary recounting the tragic events of August 1979, when one of the world's leading sailing races - the Fastnet Race - was hit by hurricane-force winds and waves up to 60ft high. The disaster took the lives of 21 people and left a lasting impact on weather forecasting and yacht safety

programme.title: Claudia Winkleman: Behind the Fringe
programme.desc: A profile of the former Strictly Come Dancing presenter and host of The Traitors, exploring her career from young TV pundit to Bafta-winning host. The programme finds out what makes her tick and what she is like when the cameras are off and looks at what is it that makes her unique. With contributions from Shirley Ballas, Kai Widdrington, Karen Hauer, Angela Rippon, Wilfred Webster, Diane Carson, Katie Puckrik, Stuart Murphy, Richard Arnold and Boyd Hilton

programme.title: William & Harry: Love & Betrayal
programme.desc: The first in a two-part documentary examining the fractured relationship between the royal brothers. Thrust into the global spotlight as children in 1997 following the untimely death of their mother, Diana, Princess of Wales, the brothers became symbols of shared grief, a bond they carried into adulthood. But as William, the heir apparent, chose stability with his marriage to Kate, Harry was more rebellious - and when he threw himself into a whirlwind romance with the American actress Meghan Markle, it became clear the brothers' relationship was changing in ways they could no longer control

programme.title: William & Harry: Love & Betrayal
programme.desc: The concluding part of the documentary picks up the story as public interest goes into overdrive over Prince Harry's relationship with American actress Meghan Markle. Things began well, with Meghan joining her future husband in his work alongside William and Kate, only for things to fall apart among rumours of bullying - by Meghan - and racism - from the royals - and Harry and Meghan's surprising decision to detach themselves from the family and move to the US. What does the future hold for the brothers?

programme.desc: Peter MacQueen considers the labrador retriever and sets out to uncover why it's Scotland's most popular breed. His first stop is a farm in Stirlingshire, where he learns about the labrador's origins as a skilled retriever, bred for fetching game from water. Eager to see these dogs in action, Peter heads to South Uist in the Outer Hebrides. Joining a shooting party before sunrise, he watches in awe as labradors plunge into cold waters, retrieving geese with ease and agility. Later, he visits Glasgow to meet some working guide dogs, discovering the breed's gentle, intelligent, and dependable qualities

programme.desc: Supernatural horror comedy starring Marianne Jean-Baptiste and Hayley Squires. programme.desc: A look at Russian billionaire Roman Abramovich's financial dealings, with new evidence from an offshore data leak suggesting his business empire was built on lies. Richard Bilton investigates Abramovich's suspect paperwork and the big accountancy firm that signed off his misleading accounts

Meanwhile, John Craven reveals the winner of this year's Countryfile Photography Competition, for Children in Need

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: Frances Tophill is tackling jobs in the autumn garden and introduces plants that keep colour and interest going for as long as possible. Jamie Butterworth delves into the fascinating world of shade-loving plants, and Ashley Edwards joins sound artist Jason Singh for an unusual journey through the garden, Plus, A couple have designed a garden around an elaborate miniature railway

programme.title: World Track Cycling Championships 2026
programme.desc: Clare Balding presents coverage of the fourth and penultimate day of the event, which takes place at Shanghai Velodrome, China. Medals are awarded in the women's madison and individual pursuit in this event last year, and Great Britain won both disciplines last year in Santiago, with the duo of Katie Archibald and Madelaine Leech taking victory in the former, and Anna Morris beating compatriot Josie Knight into second place in the latter. With analysis from Laura Kenny

programme.title: North by Northwest
programme.desc: Classic spy thriller starring Cary Grant, Eva Marie Saint and James Mason. Advertising executive Roger Thornhill finds his life in deadly peril when he is mistaken for the mysterious "Mr Kaplan" by ruthless members of an enemy spy network. Failing to convince them of his identity, Thornhill tracks down the one man who can prove his story only to find himself accused of murder.

programme.title: Flog It!
programme.desc: Paul Martin and the team value antiques at the Museum of Science and Industry in Manchester. Experts Anita Manning and Michael Baggott inspect some high-quality Danish silver, and a pot of gold. Meanwhile, Paul is taken on an architectural tour of the city, and examines a replica of the first-ever computer

programme.title: Wilderness with Simon Reeve
programme.desc: Simon journeys deep into Canada's vast and empty Yukon Territory, one of North America's most remote landscapes. Covering an area almost the size of Spain but home to fewer than 50,000 people, the Yukon is a land of immense forests, glaciers, rivers and wildlife. Simon wants to find out how the people and the wildlife of this immense wilderness are faring, all while searching for grizzly bears

programme.title: Where Eagles Dare
programme.desc: Second World War action written by Alistair MacLean and starring Richard Burton and Clint Eastwood as members of an elite group of commandos who must enter an almost impregnable Nazi stronghold to rescue a high ranking American officer.

programme.title: 40 Hits of 1986 at the BBC
programme.desc: A selection of archive performances from the year, featuring A Different Corner by George Michael, Simply Red's Holding Back the Years, Touch Me by Samantha Fox and Jermaine Stewart's We Don't Have to Take Our Clothes Off. Plus, appearances by Pet Shop Boys, A-ha, Eurythmics, Erasure, Nick Berry, Falco, Nana Mouskouri and Europe

programme.title: TOTP 1986: Big Hits
programme.desc: A look back at some of the records that dominated the year, featuring songs by Bon Jovi, Cyndi Lauper, Cameo, the Pretenders, the Real Thing, Billy Ocean and the Communards. Other highlights include the Housemartins, Kim Wilde, the Human League and the Cure

programme.title: Top of the Pops: The Story of 1986
programme.desc: A look back at the year when Simply Red, the Housemartins, Sinitta, the Communards and Swing Out Sister hit the charts. It was a time that saw the advent of house music, the big bang in the money markets and political fatigue on the left. How did these real-world events make their mark on the nation's most popular show?

He becomes a regular at Springfield Elementary's canteen where he learns a new parenting technique to try out on Bart and Lisa - but its overbearing nature leads to disaster. Meanwhile, Marge enjoys a sauna she discovers in the basement

programme.title: The Simpsons
programme.desc: Marge and Homer rent an apartment in an affluent area so their children can have a good education when Springfield Elementary is rated the worst school in the state. Bart wastes no time in establishing a bad-boy persona, and increases Lisa's popularity by telling people she knows a pop star. With the voice of Elliot Page (Juno)

programme.title: The Simpsons
programme.desc: Marge takes Lisa for her first manicure at the salon, where they debate whether a woman can be smart, beautiful and powerful all at the same time. Four tales featuring strong women from history and literature are retold with Selma appearing as Elizabeth I, Lisa as Snow White, Marge as Lady Macbeth and Maggie as Howard Roark from The Fountainhead

programme.title: The Simpsons
programme.desc: An outbreak of food poisoning at Krusty Burger is traced to barley produced in a nearby town of Norwegian immigrants and results in the mills being shut down, so the out-of-work residents venture to Springfield to find new jobs. However, when xenophobia starts to spread, Mayor Quimby decides to shut the borders

programme.title: The Simpsons
programme.desc: Grampa gets a hearing aid which tells him more about the world than he wants to know. Skinner learns that his mother shattered his boyhood dream.

programme.title: The Simpsons
programme.desc: A look at Lisa's life from talking toddler to college-bound. Plus Homer enters a 12-step plan.

programme.title: The Simpsons
programme.desc: Lisa meets a jazz-addicted boy and must choose between him and Nelson. Meanwhile, Bart takes up chemistry, but to what end?

programme.title: The Simpsons
programme.desc: Burns fears the end of the world and builds a cosmic ark. When he tests the town for worthiness, Marge is dismayed when Bart comes out on the bottom.

programme.title: The Simpsons
programme.desc: Homer gets a new job at a better nuclear power plant, forcing the family to move to an apparently idyllic community - but his boss turns out to be a megalomaniac super-villain with dreams of world domination. Featuring the guest voice of Albert Brooks

programme.title: The Simpsons
programme.desc: Moe is elated to discover Homer was born with a unique genetic condition that protects his brain from injury, and decides to cash in by training him to be a boxer. Featuring the guest voice of Paul Winfield

programme.title: The Simpsons
programme.desc: We learn that Chief Wiggum's wife is more than she seems. Marge takes part in a jewel heist.

programme.title: The Simpsons
programme.desc: Mr. Burns gets into the plant-based burger business. Lisa refuses to believe he's up to no good.

programme.title: Gogglebox
programme.desc: Compilation of highlights from series 27, in which the Goggleboxers check out more of the biggest and best TV

programme.title: Celebrity Gogglebox
programme.desc: Denise Van Outen and her partner Eddie, Nick Grimshaw and his niece Liv, Zoe Ball and her son Woody Cook, Martin Kemp and son Roman Kemp, Maureen Lipman and Gyles Brandreth, Johnny Vegas and his PA Bev, Emilia Fox and Joanna David, Eamonn Holmes and Ruth Langsford and Laura Whitmore and Iain Stirling offer sharp, insightful, funny and sometimes emotional critiques of Bake Off: The Professionals, Ramsay's 24 Hours to Hell and Back, Celebrity MasterChef, The Supervet: Noel Fitzpatrick, Grease and Thelma & Louise

programme.title: Gogglebox
programme.desc: The armchair critics settle down to appraise shows including Strictly Come Dancing, Married at First Sight UK, Rivals, Antiques Roadshow, Love Triangle Australia, Ambulance, Countdown and ITV News coverage of the re-election of Donald Trump as US president

programme.title: The Inbetweeners
programme.desc: Will is asked to help co-ordinate the school's Duke of Edinburgh award scheme, but instead of carrying out his duties, he turns the situation to his advantage and tries to flirt with a university student. Meanwhile, Simon faces problems when his parents separate. Simon Bird and Joe Thomas star

programme.title: The Inbetweeners
programme.desc: Will becomes stressed as the friends prepare for their exams - apart from Jay, who finds himself preoccupied. Simon makes progress with Carli by helping her revise, and they all reminisce about the events of the past year. Comedy, starring Simon Bird

programme.title: The Inbetweeners
programme.desc: At the start of the new term, Carli organises a fashion show that Simon is eager to participate in. Will tries to shake off his embarrassing reputation, while Jay continues to lie about his sexual experiences. Comedy, starring Emily Head, Joe Thomas, Simon Bird, James Buckley and Blake Harrison

programme.title: The Inbetweeners
programme.desc: Simon goes to his first gig since seeing Take That at Wembley Arena, hoping to impress an attractive girl in the year below, but Will, Jay and Neil tag along and jeopardise his chances of wooing her. Comedy, starring Joe Thomas, Simon Bird, James Buckley and Blake Harrison

programme.title: 8 Out of 10 Cats Does Countdown
programme.desc: Jimmy Carr hosts the comedy words-and-numbers quiz, with Sean Lock and guest captain Sarah Millican joined by Roisin Conaty and Rhod Gilbert. David O'Doherty presides alongside Countdown regular Susie Dent in Dictionary Corner, while Rachel Riley provides the letters and numbers

programme.title: Friday Night Dinner
programme.desc: Dad seems terribly miserable on his birthday, and no one seems to know the reason why. Mum, Adam and Jonny are dumbstruck when he finally reveals the reason is that he's realised he'll never go into space because he has used a website to calculate the date he's going to die. Jim conjures up some special 'tricks' for the occasion and Grandma Goodma - aka Horrible Grandma - turns up uninvited, thus making a terrible birthday the worst yet. Comedy, starring Paul Ritter, Simon Bird, Tom Rosenthal and Tamsin Greig

programme.title: Friday Night Dinner
programme.desc: Mum is in hospital having a 'woman's procedure', so Aunty Val is tasked with making the Friday night dinner. To Adam and Jonny's horror, she spends most of the evening glued to a dating app, before showing them several photos of semi-naked men. Val is especially obsessed with one guy, who goes by the name of Loverboy 309. The object of her lust is picking Val up from the house in 40 minutes. Thus begins an evening of hell for the Goodmans, as Val forces them to eat their lamb dinner in record time. Comedy, starring Paul Ritter, Simon Bird, Tom Rosenthal, Tamsin Greig and Tracy-Ann Oberman

programme.title: Couples Come Dine with Me
programme.desc: Three rival couples battle it out to host the best dinner party in Newcastle. Partners Fiona and Hannah kick things off with their Moroccan-themed menu. Couple David and Sonia, and childhood sweethearts Claire and Steven, all agree the puppet show was unexpected. Day two sees Steven and Claire's German-inspired menu. Finally, David decides a charm offensive is needed for his and Sonia's night

programme.title: Couples Come Dine with Me
programme.desc: Three couples from Durham compete to host the best dinner party, beginning with Steph and James, who offer a night of gastropub favourites. Day two sees animal-lovers Gary and Amanda serve up two courses of fish on their homely-menu, and hosts Andy and Emma feel confident on the final night of the competition

programme.title: Property Brothers: Buying and Selling
programme.desc: The DIY duo are back for series four! You know the drill: expect funky furnishings, hardware hysteria and, of course, problematic properties. Can Jonathan and Drew reverse more housing screw-ups? Michelle's starter home has been bursting at the seams since Danielle and their three little ones came along. But, after buying it for a top market price, she wants to ensure she's not losing any money. Will a huge renovation courtesy of the brothers secure a high-selling sum? programme.title: Property Brothers: Buying and Selling

programme.title: Don't Tell the Bride
programme.desc: Sonny is a party fanatic. What will his bride Jazmin think of his plans for a zoo-themed Ibizan beach party with body paint?

programme.title: Don't Tell the Bride
programme.desc: The sky's the limit for adrenaline junkie Jai as he plans on having a wedding on a platform suspended in mid-air, neglecting the fact that his bride-to-be Leanne is terrified of heights

programme.title: Don't Tell the Bride
programme.desc: Will Andy's plans for a skater-themed wedding make his bride Bobby's wheels spin? Or will there be broken bones and broken hearts on the big day?

programme.desc: Platinum-selling, Grammy-nominated singer-songwriter, actor and author Jewel goes undercover to meet talented musicians and artists struggling to break through. programme.title: Celebrity Undercover Boss USA
programme.desc: Stephanie McMahon, former women's champion and chief brand officer of the WWE, goes undercover to help make aspiring wrestlers and fans' dreams come true

programme.desc: Gordon Ramsay revisits some of the restaurants that he set out to save, including the Mixing Bowl, the Olde Stone Mill, Peter's and Campania. Have their owners pulled themselves out of their nightmares?

programme.title: Ramsay's Kitchen Nightmares USA
programme.desc: The chef again comes to the aid of failing American restaurants, starting in Fishtown, Philadelphia, where he tries to help the three owners of the Hot Potato Cafe, which has not made a profit in two years. Spurred on by a scathing review by an influential critic, he makes radical changes to alter the staff's attitudes and create food that is up to his own exacting standards

programme.title: Ramsay's Kitchen Nightmares USA
programme.desc: The chef travels to Flamangos restaurant in Whitehouse, New Jersey, where he tries to help the mother-and-daughter owners turn around their struggling business's fortunes. He faces a struggle because parent Adelle has a bad relationship with her staff and is disappointed by the resident chef, leaving Gordon with the added challenge of changing her attitude

programme.title: Ramsay's Kitchen Nightmares USA
programme.desc: Gordon Ramsay gives his advice to Paul Bazzini, an award-winning chef from New York who now owns a restaurant in Ridgewood, New Jersey. programme.title: Ramsay's Kitchen Nightmares USA
programme.desc: Gordon Ramsay visits Mojito, a Cuban cafe in Brooklyn, New York. The restaurant was the shared dream of two newlyweds who have separated since its opening, and whose constant public quarrelling is distracting staff and driving customers away

programme.title: Alita: Battle Angel
programme.desc: Science-fiction action adventure starring Rosa Salazar and Christoph Waltz. On a future Earth, Dr Dyson Ido reawakens a dormant cyborg and names her "Alita". With no memory of her past, Alita determines to find out what she can, while exploring the dark depths of Iron City. But when she's targeted by a vicious band of cyborg serial killers, Alita discovers she is a formidable fighter, a revelation that tips her into a dangerous new world.

programme.title: The Second Act
programme.desc: David arranges for his friend Willy to woo his clingy girlfriend Florence during a meeting with her father. As the awkward encounter unfolds, the actors repeatedly break character, revealing they're filming an AI-directed movie, where on-set tensions, personal anxieties and reality increasingly blur with the fictional romantic drama. Writer-director Quentin Dupieux's comedy, starring Léa Seydoux and Vincent Lindon. In French, with English subtitles

programme.title: Hail the Conquering Hero
programme.desc: Comedy starring Eddie Bracken and Ella Raines. Woodrow Truesmith is disappointed at being invalided out of the services by chronic hay fever, so a group of genuine heroes take pity on him, determined he should return home in style.

programme.title: The Art of Racing in the Rain
programme.desc: Comedy drama starring Amanda Seyfried and Milo Ventimiglia, and featuring the voice of Kevin Costner. The ups and downs of a young family are seen through the eyes of their beloved golden retriever.

programme.title: The Bridge on the River Kwai
programme.desc: Second World War epic starring Alec Guinness, William Holden and Jack Hawkins. Despite being held in a Japanese PoW camp in Burma, Colonel Nicholson still runs his regiment by the military textbook. However, Nicholson meets his match in the equally stubborn prison commander Colonel Saito, and the two find themselves on a collision course when Saito gets orders to build a strategically important railway bridge.

programme.title: Battleship
programme.desc: Sci-fi action adventure starring Liam Neeson, Taylor Kitsch, Alexander Skarsgård and Rihanna. Three ships, which are part of an international fleet on manoeuvres near Hawaii, are cut off by a force field when alien craft attack. As the fighting intensifies, it soon becomes clear the crews are fighting for the survival of the Earth itself.

programme.title: American Star
programme.desc: Out to kill a man he has never met, Wilson, a seasoned assassin completing his final assignment in Fuerteventura, is drawn to a ghostly shipwreck. Thriller, starring Ian McShane, Nora Arnezeder and Fanny Ardant

programme.title: Lisa Frankenstein
programme.desc: Romantic comedy horror starring Kathryn Newton and Cole Sprouse. As a child, Lisa Swallows was traumatised when she witnessed the murder of her mother. Now a teenage outsider, she fantasises about a Victorian gentleman whose grave she tends. When a lightning strike reanimates his corpse, she helps him to heal by gathering together the body parts he is missing - which she chooses to "acquire" from her mortal enemies.

programme.title: Alita: Battle Angel
programme.desc: Science-fiction action adventure starring Rosa Salazar and Christoph Waltz. On a future Earth, Dr Dyson Ido reawakens a dormant cyborg and names her "Alita". With no memory of her past, Alita determines to find out what she can, while exploring the dark depths of Iron City. But when she's targeted by a vicious band of cyborg serial killers, Alita discovers she is a formidable fighter, a revelation that tips her into a dangerous new world.

programme.title: The Second Act
programme.desc: David arranges for his friend Willy to woo his clingy girlfriend Florence during a meeting with her father. As the awkward encounter unfolds, the actors repeatedly break character, revealing they're filming an AI-directed movie, where on-set tensions, personal anxieties and reality increasingly blur with the fictional romantic drama. Writer-director Quentin Dupieux's comedy, starring Léa Seydoux and Vincent Lindon. In French, with English subtitles

programme.title: Hail the Conquering Hero
programme.desc: Comedy starring Eddie Bracken and Ella Raines. Woodrow Truesmith is disappointed at being invalided out of the services by chronic hay fever, so a group of genuine heroes take pity on him, determined he should return home in style.

programme.title: The Art of Racing in the Rain
programme.desc: Comedy drama starring Amanda Seyfried and Milo Ventimiglia, and featuring the voice of Kevin Costner. The ups and downs of a young family are seen through the eyes of their beloved golden retriever.

programme.title: The Bridge on the River Kwai
programme.desc: Second World War epic starring Alec Guinness, William Holden and Jack Hawkins. Despite being held in a Japanese PoW camp in Burma, Colonel Nicholson still runs his regiment by the military textbook. However, Nicholson meets his match in the equally stubborn prison commander Colonel Saito, and the two find themselves on a collision course when Saito gets orders to build a strategically important railway bridge.

programme.title: Battleship
programme.desc: Sci-fi action adventure starring Liam Neeson, Taylor Kitsch, Alexander Skarsgård and Rihanna. Three ships, which are part of an international fleet on manoeuvres near Hawaii, are cut off by a force field when alien craft attack. As the fighting intensifies, it soon becomes clear the crews are fighting for the survival of the Earth itself.

programme.title: American Star
programme.desc: Out to kill a man he has never met, Wilson, a seasoned assassin completing his final assignment in Fuerteventura, is drawn to a ghostly shipwreck. Thriller, starring Ian McShane, Nora Arnezeder and Fanny Ardant

programme.title: Lisa Frankenstein
programme.desc: Romantic comedy horror starring Kathryn Newton and Cole Sprouse. As a child, Lisa Swallows was traumatised when she witnessed the murder of her mother. Now a teenage outsider, she fantasises about a Victorian gentleman whose grave she tends. When a lightning strike reanimates his corpse, she helps him to heal by gathering together the body parts he is missing - which she chooses to "acquire" from her mortal enemies.

programme.desc: Tori Herridge and a team of scientists attempt to piece together the lives behind discovered bones, and find out what happened to these people and how they died. One of them is an old woman, who has been manipulated into a position where she is pointing at something. But at what? And why?

programme.title: Secrets of Great British Castles
programme.desc: Dan Jones explores the 900-year history of Leeds Castle in Kent, from its origins as a royal Saxon family's manor and Norman stronghold to the private property of six medieval queens, a Tudor palace, a Jacobean country house and a Georgian mansion. Its last owner, Lady Olive Baillie, made it a centre of lavish hospitality for leading politicians, international royalty and film stars. When she died in 1974, she bequeathed the castle and grounds to a specially created charitable trust so that future generations could enjoy her home

programme.desc: In the quest for world domination, the Nazis built some of the biggest and deadliest pieces of military hardware and malevolent technology in history. This programme explores the story behind one of the most technologically advanced aeroplanes of the Second World War, awe-inspiring fighter jet the Messerschmitt Me 262, and the huge subterranean cave where it was built

programme.title: Apocalypse: The Rise of Hitler
programme.desc: Part one of two. Documentary charting the dictator's rise to power, from his beginnings as a struggling artist in Vienna to his eventual demise in Berlin. The first episode focuses on Hitler's formative years and how, when he returned home from the First World War, his nationalistic diatribes were largely ignored by the public, until the 1929 economic crisis put him and his ideas in the spotlight

programme.title: Apocalypse: The Rise of Hitler
programme.desc: Part two of two. Hitler becomes chancellor in 1933 after the German economy collapses and sets out to ensure the Nazi party's members dominate every aspect of society. One year later, he is proclaimed Fuhrer, beginning an ideological and military programme that eventually lead to the invasion of Poland and the start of the Second World War

programme.title: How the Tudors Lost Their Heads
programme.desc: Margaret Pole was born into England's ruling dynasty but lost her wealth and status when the Tudors came to power. Resilient and smart, she fought her way back to become one of the country's most powerful people. She was trusted by Henry VIII to be his daughter Mary's governess but was also willing to defy the king. Suzannah Lipscomb and Dan Snow trace Margaret's incredible story and investigate her downfall, exploring castles across England and heading to Europe on the trail of her son, Reginald. A protégé of Henry VIII, he turned against the king over the break with Catholic Rome. Reginald's 'betrayal' led to an international manhunt that endangered his family and eventually led to Margaret's conviction as a traitor. Killed at the age of 67, her execution is remembered as one of the most shocking of Tudor times.

programme.desc: Sue from Manchester brings Brenton West a prized tea set given to her by her Uncle John. A collapsed kitchen shelf has left the set dented and out of shape but Sue has high hopes for the silversmith's ability to fix it. Sarah brings in a cast-iron post box for metals expert Dominic Chinea to salvage. Forty-years standing in the garden has taken its toll and Sarah and her family full of posties are hoping Dom can bring it back to its former glory. Philip brings Suzie Fletcher a leather folder that symbolises his family's wartime experience

programme.title: The Repair Shop
programme.desc: Vanessa Simonite with what appears to be a piece of wood and a bag of bits, but which once was a beautiful mosaic table made by hand by her late husband. On hand to help repair this ultimate jigsaw puzzle is the barn's ceramic expert Kirsten Ramsay with help from woodwork whizz Will Kirk. A well-loved family recipe book and an art deco clock also receive much-needed restorations

programme.title: The Repair Shop
programme.desc:
Jay Blades and the team bring three treasured family heirlooms, and the memories they hold, back to life.
First into the barn, for the attention of silversmith Brenton West, is a small metal statue that once stood proudly in the garden of Helen Elverstone's grandparents. Now the human figure has broken in two, with one leg still embedded in rock while the rest of the body has snapped off at the waist. After Helen's grandparents died, the statue went to live in her mum's garden, and Helen has fond memories of times sat talking with her mum in her special place - the garden - next to the statue. Sadly, just after the death of her mother, Helen found the statue lying broken on the ground. Now she hopes Brenton can piece this little part of her family history back together again.
Next, horologist Steve Fletcher has his skills tested by a timepiece all the way from Trinidad. Sashtee Tirbhowen's clock has been in her family for four generations, and she remembers being woken by the clock every morning. The clock survived the long journey to England, but it didn't fare so well after a leak brought a ceiling down on top of it. Sashtee couldn't forgive herself for the damage to her dad's precious clock, and is hoping Steve can help her make amends by getting it working once again.
Amanda Anderson arrives with a painting of her grandmother at the age of 19, and a tale of long-lost love, for art conservator Lucia Scalisi. The artist was also her grandmother's first love, but when the slightly older artist approached her father for her hand in marriage, he was refused. Amanda was very close to her grandmother, who continued to be a part of the Glasgow art scene, and on her death the portrait passed to Amanda. But now the glamorous figure in the painting is being let down by the condition of the canvas and the frame. It's down to Lucia to restore the painting to its former glory.

programme.title: The Repair Shop
programme.desc: The expert restoration team bring three treasured family heirlooms back from the brink. They revive a 19th century Indian ceremonial coat, a homemade kid's motorbike and a vintage handbag from NYC.

programme.title: The Repair Shop
programme.desc: The expert restoration team bring three treasured family heirlooms back from the brink. They revive a garden gate from Roald Dahl's mother's house, a homemade model of a prawn trawler and a miniature Irish dancing dress.

programme.title: The Repair Shop
programme.desc: Peter Shahbenderian hopes wood expert Will Kirk can restore a pair of ornate Turkish bath clogs to their former glory. They were brought to the UK by Peter's mother when her family left Constantinople at the time of the Armenian genocide. Silversmith Brenton West is presented with two Isle of Man Manx Grand Prix trophies by Barrie James, which represent one of the greatest achievement of his father's racing days. Sadly over the years the trophies have become tarnished and broken. Presented by Jay Blades

programme.title: The Repair Shop
programme.desc:
Jay Blades and the team bring three treasured family heirlooms, and the memories they hold, back to life.
Sizing up the barn's latest project, electronics whizz Mark Stuckey is hoping for the sweet sound of success as he fixes a 60-year-old sound system and cocktail cabinet. This vintage radiogram belongs to Clifton Smith and was once the pride and joy of his parents, providing the soundtrack to many happy family events. The last time Clifton heard it playing properly was at a party the night before he joined the army at the age of 16 over 40 years ago. Now he is pinning his hopes on Mark's electrical know-how to get it spinning discs once again.
Lydia Lewis is the next arrival, with a tricky little trinket for horologist Steve Fletcher. It is a mid-20th-century treasure that used to grace her grandmother's drinks trolley. It looks like a vintage telephone, but the base contains a hidden musical box that plays when the receiver is lifted, while the receiver itself cleverly conceals a lighter. Though her grandmother died before she was born, Lydia loves the telephone and would like to see it working again as it did when her grandmother was alive. Steve's challenge is to fix the lighter mechanism and repair the broken mouthpiece.
Finally, the perfect job for master saddlemaker Suzie Fletcher - a saddle. But Elana Beavis's saddle is no ordinary saddle. It travelled around Canada with her great-grandparents after they quit farming in England for a new life across the Atlantic running a rodeo. After many adventures, the family eventually moved back to the UK, with the elaborate saddle being one of the few possessions they just couldn't leave behind. Now Lydia would like to restore the worn-out leather work as a tribute to her intrepid ancestors.

programme.title: Planet Earth III
programme.desc: The wildlife inhabiting the world's oceans, from the shallow seas of the tropics, where predators like the lionfish can become the prey to one of the world's oddest hunters, to the greatest depths, where a massive siphonophore, longer than a blue whale, and a gulper eel with huge jaws are captured on film using specialised vessels designed to withstand the pressure. The episode also features the mating dances of mobula rays and the symbiotic relationship between Columbus crabs and turtles

programme.title: Planet Earth III
programme.desc: Life in some of the many deserts and grasslands around the world, including in the baked Namib desert, where a pair of ostriches raise their family in the searing heat to keep them safe from predators. One troop of desert baboons are on a continual quest to find water and a young mother who is low in the pecking order must battle for her right to drink. Closer to the equator, in the grassland paradise of the Cerrado in Brazil, lives the rare, fruit-eating maned wolf, a bizarre creature about whom little is known

programme.title: Planet Earth III
programme.desc: Footage of animals that live in freshwater environments, from gliding treefrogs engaged in fiercely competitive mating rituals in in the Costa Rican rainforest to mugger crocodiles in Sri Lanka, that lie in wait at waterholes for chital deer. In the Okavango Delta, the arrival of the great annual flood poses a significant challenge for a pack of five African wild dogs

programme.title: Planet Earth III

programme.desc: The wildlife inhabiting the world's oceans, from the shallow seas of the tropics, where predators like the lionfish can become the prey to one of the world's oddest hunters, to the greatest depths, where a massive siphonophore, longer than a blue whale, and a gulper eel with huge jaws are captured on film using specialised vessels designed to withstand the pressure. Closer to the equator, in the grassland paradise of the Cerrado in Brazil, lives the rare, fruit-eating maned wolf, a bizarre creature about whom little is known

programme.title: Would I Lie to You?

programme.title: Ghosts
programme.desc: Christmas comes to the haunted household of Button House in this festive special, and Alison and Mike prepare to host a family Christmas for the first time. Alison finds her phantom housemates less than filled with festive cheer, and learns that Christmas is never easy when you're dead. Mike comes up with a dubious plan to get his parents into the holiday spirit, while Julian is confronted by a new arrival, who forces him to relive memories of his life and come to terms with his past misdeeds

programme.title: Ghosts
programme.desc: A film crew comes to Button House to shoot a reconstruction of an assassination plot for a historical documentary - a scheme which may have involved one of the spirits. Mike persuades Alison to give an interview about the old house in the hope of drumming up some publicity, forcing her to turn to Thomas for advice on the art of public speaking

programme.title: Ghosts
programme.desc: A mysterious visitor arrives at Button House, with a revelation that leaves Alison reeling. Thomas is confused by his feelings for this strange arrival, while Lady Button and Julian warn of sinister motives, and Kitty is as territorial as ever. Mike has an epiphany on his first day at a new job, which triggers Julian to remember his first day as a ghost

programme.title: Not Going Out
programme.desc: It's been over a year since Frank's death and Wendy, rediscovering a long lost love for painting, decides to create a very unique tribute to him in oils. The usually curmudgeonly Geoffrey seems very keen on the commemorative artwork, but Lee and Lucy simply hate it. Once it's hanging on their wall, the pair contrive to 'lose' the painting without Wendy or Geoffrey noticing. Comedy, starring Lee Mack, Sally Bretton, Deborah Grant and Geoffrey Whitehead

programme.title: Not Going Out
programme.desc: When Lee accidentally sends a rude text about Anna to Lucy, he makes the silly mistake of sending it to Anna herself. Lee and Lucy now face the impossible task of stealing Anna's phone and deleting the text before she read it. Comedy, starring Lee Mack and Sally Bretton, with Abigail Cruttenden

programme.title: Not Going Out
programme.desc: Lucy is worried Lee is becoming isolated and friendless after noticing he makes no effort to talk to other parents in the playground. She encourages him to make an effort to bond with them and he reluctantly agrees to give it a try. He opens up with strangers and makes friends with another lone male, Keith. However, Keith is even less sociable than Lee. Comedy, starring Lee Mack and Sally Bretton, with Joe Wilkinson

programme.title: Would I Lie to You? at Christmas
